name: Jijaji Chhat Par Hai
description: Two men live as fake husband and wife only to find a shelter and work, meanwhile focusing on their music career. While the teenage daughter of their landlord and boss becomes attracted to one of them.

videos.title: The Popular Elaichi
videos.overview: Sethji is getting a shave. The barber informs him that his daughter, Elaichi is having a flirtatious affair with Sethji's servant.

videos.title: Pancham The Singer
videos.overview: Elaichi continues to spy on Pancham. When he goes in for his bath, she drenches him with water. Once she escapes, Pancham starts singing.

videos.title: The Honesty Test
videos.overview: Elaichi's father is about to test Pancham's honesty. He plants some money to see if Pancham will take it. Elaichi hopes to help Pancham.

videos.title: Elaichi The Snake
videos.overview: Elaichi pretends to be a snake. So Pancham takes it upon himself to know more about Elaichi. However, Elaichi continues to torment Pancham by pretending to be a snake.

videos.title: Elaichi Torments Pancham
videos.overview: Elaichi continues to have fun by tormenting Pancham. He tries to avoid her as he believes she is a snake.

videos.title: The Snake Dance
videos.overview: Pancham is very apprehensive about the snake dance Elaichi has invited him to. When he arrives she tells him that she will turn him into a snake. He gets scared. So Elaichi tells him that she won't turn him into a snake if he does a snake dance with her.

videos.title: Elaichi's Song
videos.overview: Elaichi visits Pancham. She tells him that she has composed a song. She invites him to have golgappas. But Pancham refuses.

videos.title: The Water Tank
videos.overview: Elaichi tells Pancham's wife that she will have to keep a fast and take a dip in the Jamuna river. To practice, Pancham and his wife go into the water tank. But Pancham's wife gets stuck in the water tank.

videos.title: Pintu is Pregnant
videos.overview: Murari informs Elaichi that Pancham's wife, Pintu, is pregnant. Hearing this, Sunita faints and Elaichi pacifies her. The question as to how Pintu can be pregnant, as they know that Pintu is a he and not she.

videos.title: When Pancham Sings
videos.overview: Pancham is forced to go on an unofficial date with Elaichi, whose father is rather perturbed at the money being spent on the delicious snacks Elaichi is eating.

videos.title: Possessed Pancham
videos.overview: Pancham is worried that the sonography report will come out negative and his lies will be exposed. He begs to Elaichi to save him. Elaichi comes up with a plan and tells her father that her grandfather's ghost has possessed Pancham.

videos.title: The Movie Plan
videos.overview: Elaichi has an idea up her sleeves. She decides to take Pancham on a movie date. But, Pancham is not interested and is not willing to negotiate.

videos.title: Pancham The Disco Dancer
videos.overview: Elaichi goes to watch a film with Pancham. Accompanying them are Elaichi's parents. After the film is over, Elaichi returns home and daydreams of disco dancing with Pancham. But, to her dismay, it's only a daydream.

videos.title: Pancham's Dance Moves
videos.overview: Elaichi knocks on the door of Pancham. As his wife quickly hides, Pancham opens the door, and Elaichi shares dinner with him. Later, while Pancham is busy selling clothes at the store, Elaichi arrives and forces him to dance with her.

videos.title: Elaichi's Plan
videos.overview: Elaichi is not able to sleep in the night, so she knocks on Pancham's door. Pancham is sleepy but is forced to stay awake as his wife asks Elaichi to stay. The next day, Elaichi asks Pancham to meet her in the evening.

videos.title: Pancham's Appointment
videos.overview: Elaichi meets Pancham and informs him that a film director wants to meet him. Pancham is unsure about his looks and hesitates to go forward with the appointment. Elaichi makes sure Pancham looks his best before his meeting.

videos.title: Elaichi and Pancham Arrested
videos.overview: Elaichi's father goes to a guest house to spy on Pancham, as he presumes that he has booked a room there. But, when he arrives with his wife, the police enters the guest house and arrest the couple.

videos.title: Out Of Jail
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham are released from the police custody. Upon returning home, Pancham learns that the police officer had visited his house. Meanwhile, Elaichi's parents manage to get a release. Elaichi's father learns that his daughter is watching Emraan Hashmi's film.

videos.title: Elaichi's Act
videos.overview: Elaichi pretends to be drunk and meets Pancham, who is panic-stricken on seeing her. Then, Elaichi and her friends reveal that it was a prank.

videos.title: Ghost In The House
videos.overview: Pancham enters Elaichi's room. Right then, Elaichi's father also arrives and tells her that he will sleep in her room. Meanwhile, Elaichi's father sees his wife walking like a ghost holding a candle.

videos.title: Sunita's Ghost
videos.overview: Pintu meets Sunita's supposed ghost while Elaichi's father faints believing that he is sleeping next to a ghost. Elaichi's father is convinced that his house is haunted by Sunita's ghost.

videos.title: The Possessed
videos.overview: Elaichi pretends to be possessed by Sunita's ghost. Pancham is shivering with fear and so is Elaichi's father, who believes that his wife is possessed. The two men take shelter in the bathroom to escape the possessed.

videos.title: The Disguise
videos.overview: The police take Pancham into custody and before the matter gets worse, Pintu arrives and gets his release. After returning home, Pintu informs Pancham that he is slowly beginning to feel like a woman due to his disguise. Pancham offers no sympathy and asks him to continue like this for some more time.

videos.title: Murari is In Trouble
videos.overview: Murari's life is under a threat. A man, who thinks Murari tried to enrage the modesty of his sister, wants to beat up Murari. Pancham has got the task of saving Murari from the furious man.

videos.title: Madly In Love
videos.overview: Lota, the goon, is madly in love with Elaichi's father, and he thinks he is a woman. Pancham tries every trick to get rid of the goon but his actions go in vain. As the last attempt, Elaichi's father takes the police's help.

videos.title: Pancham - The Hero
videos.overview: The day has arrived when Murari has to marry Lota. He tries to avert the disaster with Pancham's help, but Lota threatens him to organize the wedding. At the wedding, Pancham gathers courage and turns out to be a hero as he beats up Lota and saves Murari from getting married.

videos.title: Pancham's Trouble
videos.overview: In Pancham's neighborhood, a politician arrives. Pancham witnesses him next to Elaichi and presumes that the politician is winking at her. Pancham gets furious and beats up the politician but this becomes a huge issue.

videos.title: Pancham's Fate
videos.overview: Netaji arrives at Pancham's shop and he hides his face so that he is not recognised. Elaichi informs her father that it was Pancham who had beaten up Netaji. Elaichi's father is worried that his shop will be demolished.

videos.title: Netaji In Trouble
videos.overview: Netaji is smitten by Pintu. When Netaji tries to get close with Pintu, Elaichi arrives and threatens Netaji that she will file a harassment case against him and also release his clip to the media. A scared Netaji has no choice but to stop the order of demolishing Murari's shop.

videos.title: Elaichi's Kidnapping
videos.overview: Elaichi wants a necklace but her father is not keen to buy it for her. So, Elaichi comes up with a plan and fakes her kidnapping in an attempt to get money from her father.

videos.title: The Kidnappers
videos.overview: Pintu is worried that the police will catch him as the ransom call was made from his phone. Pancham throws the phone in fear of being caught. Meanwhile, Murari informs the police about Elaichi's kidnapping.

videos.title: Elaichi Returns Home
videos.overview: Pintu makes another phone call to Murari and asks him to send the money. Murari agrees and Elaichi returns home.

videos.title: Elaichi's Wish Fulfilled
videos.overview: Murari is forced to believe that his brother-in-law is the one who kidnapped Elaichi. Then, Murari decides to fulfill his daughter's wish by presenting her with a necklace.

videos.title: Romance is In The Air
videos.overview: Elaichi pretends to be married to Pancham in front of a stranger. Later, Elaichi emotionally blackmails Pancham and asks him to pretend to be her lover.

videos.title: Pancham is In Trouble
videos.overview: Elaichi's prospective groom pays a visit to her house with his family. As the marriage is being finalized, Elaichi lies to the guy that she is pregnant with Pancham's child. Elaichi's mother overhears this conversation and is deeply shocked.

videos.title: Panchams Misery Continues
videos.overview: Elaichi's mother and Chatanki decide to beat Pancham to teach him a lesson. But, they end up thrashing Murari. Later, Murari learns that Elaichi is pregnant with Pancham's child. He decides to end Pancham's life but before the tragedy occurs. Elaichi intervenes and informs her father that she lied about the pregnancy to avoid marriage.

videos.title: Bhaang Ke Laddoo For Murari
videos.overview: Elaichi throws a bucket of water on Pancham as a Holi prank. Karuna's brother pitches her the idea of giving 'bhaang ke laddoo' to Murari.

videos.title: Elaichi's Holi Plans
videos.overview: Elaichi and Sunita have made plans for the Holi celebrations. Pancham gets terrified upon hearing what they have in store for him.

videos.title: Elaichi Celebrates Holi
videos.overview: Elaichi hides her father's spectacles so that he does not see their Holi celebrations. When she applies colors on Pancham, he is sacred that her father might catch them. But, when he gets to know that Murari cannot see clearly without glasses, he enjoys whole-heartedly.

videos.title: Pancham's Divorce
videos.overview: Elaichi informs Pancham that Murari and Karuna are not her real parents and cajoles him to marry her. The next day, Elaichi arrives with a defense lawyer in an attempt to get Pancham and Pintu divorced.

videos.title: Elaichi's Con
videos.overview: Elaichi tries to con Pancham into getting a divorce with Pintu so she can marry him. Murari tries to save his marriage after his failed attempt at romance with his wife. Murari and Karuna plan to recapture the magic of their youth.

videos.title: Elaichi's Escape Plan
videos.overview: Elaichi convinces Pancham to elope with her. Pancham is scared and thinks of the repercussions. Nevertheless, Pancham has no choice but to do as Elaichi says. Later, while Elaichi is about to leave the house, she changes her plan and decides to stay back.

videos.title: Elaichi Reveals The Truth
videos.overview: Pancham learns that Elaichi has lied to him. When Elaichi informs Pancham that they should drop the plan to elope together, Pancham insists that they should elope. Then, Elaichi ends up revealing that she cooked up the story just to force Pancham to run away with her.

videos.title: Pyar Aur Takrar
videos.overview: Murari asks Pintu to sleep in his room. Murari's wife informs her brother that Murari is upset with her. Elaichi arrives in Pancham's room and presumes that the one sleeping on the bed is Pancham.

videos.title: Confusion
videos.overview: Elaichi comes to Pancham's room and finds someone sleeping in the room. Little did she knew that it was Muari sleeping in Pancham's room.

videos.title: Karuna's Heartbreak
videos.overview: Pancham dresses up as a woman and meets Murari. Karuna presumes that Murari is having an affair and decides to take action. Karuna finds out that the woman she is envious of, is no one else but, Pancham.

videos.title: The Boyfriend
videos.overview: Pancham gets caught in between when he tries to work for Elaichi's plan to put the spark back in her parent's marriage life.

videos.title: The Hypnosis
videos.overview: Elaichi sees Lalit hypnotizing a man. She decides to hypnotize Pancham and make him do what she wants him to. While trying to hypnotize Pancham, Elaichi ends up getting hypnotized and starts believing that Pancham is her husband.

videos.title: The Hair Cut
videos.overview: In front of Murari, Elaichi refers to Pancham as her husband, which leaves Murari startled. Later that night, Chatanki sneaks into Murari's room and tries to cut his hair. Murari wakes up and chases Chatanki believing that he is a thief.

videos.title: The Drama
videos.overview: Chhatanki gets some hair of Murari with the help of his sister, to perform a charm under the guidance of a black-magician. Murari is confused as to why Elaichi is failing over and over again in her classes.

videos.title: Murari's Misery
videos.overview: When Murari pressurizes Elaichi to tell the truth, she finally reveals that she was pretending to be Pancham's wife and it was a prank. Later, Chhatanki informs his sister that he has lost the money she had given him.

videos.title: The Income Tax Raid
videos.overview: The income tax department arrives at Murari's shop to search. The team finds a stack of cash in Murari's house. The income tax officer, while conducting the search, comes across Pancham and falls in love with him. Later that day, the officer arrives at Murari's house to stay at his house and be close to Pancham.

videos.title: Pancham's Misery
videos.overview: Elaichi thinks that Pancham likes the income tax officer and scolds him. But Pancham assures her that he does not like her. When Elaichi sees Pancham eating snacks with the income tax officer, she gets irked.

videos.title: The Bribe
videos.overview: Elaichi bribes Pinki with her father's recipe to help her trap Jwala. With Pancham as the bait, she pulls a plan to entrap Jwala.

videos.title: The Drama Clash
videos.overview: Sunita has invited Pintu to act in a drama she is in. She gives him a male role which he gladly accepts. Meanwhile, Elaichi plans to take the roles for herself and Pancham. Little do they know that someone else has the same plan.

videos.title: The Play
videos.overview: Neena decides to take the religious path and conduct a ritual to get rid of the ghost. Meanwhile, Manav calls up Gogol and informs him that Adi is missing.

videos.title: Comical Play
videos.overview: The play's script is gone with the wind as everyone starts acting and reciting dialogues out of the script. The play takes a comical turn and amidst the laughter, the thieves who are searching for valuables, cut the power supply to accomplish their task.

videos.title: A Safehouse
videos.overview: Chotte advises Murari to invest in a cheap plot. On the way back from the bank, Inspector Pinki informs them that there is a thief out on the streets, who targets people coming out of a bank. Scared Murari looks for a place to hide his money.

videos.title: Murari's House, The Next Target
videos.overview: The robbers target Murari's house, but before they could get the money, Elaichi steals the money and hides it under her bed so that the thieves cannot find it.

videos.title: The Recovery
videos.overview: Elaichi, along with everyone, realizes that the bag which had her dad's life savings, has been stolen. Now, Gugu comes back with the bag and claims to have fought the robbers and recovered the bag.

videos.title: Dog Marriage
videos.overview: Murari is having Elaichi's future checked with an astrologer. The astrologer tells him that the possibility of her getting married is less and gives him a weird solution to solve the problem.

videos.title: Confusion
videos.overview: Elaichi exploits the confusion between a dog named Chhote and a salon owner named Chhote. Jijaji gets extremely envious of her.

videos.title: What to do Now
videos.overview: Elaichi exploits the confusion between a dog named Chhote and a salon owner named Chhote. Jijaji gets extremely envious of her.

videos.title: Meet Chhote
videos.overview: Elaichi exploits the confusion between a dog named Chhote and a salon owner named Chhote. Jijaji gets extremely envious of her.

videos.title: Pancham's Heroic Act
videos.overview: Seeing that a few goons are troubling Elaichi, Pancham shows heroic moves, and confronts them. Later, Elaichi informs Sunita that they should tell the truth to Pancham and Sunita should confess her love for Pintu.

videos.title: The Security Guard
videos.overview: Elaichi persuades Murari to hire a security guard. Then, she informs Pintu that a security guard is needed for the shop. Pintu arrives to get the job but Murari informs that he has already given the job to Chatanki.

videos.title: The New Security Guard
videos.overview: Pintu is eager to replace Chatanki as the security guard. When Chatanki is accused of harassment by a woman, he is forced to quit. Even though Pancham does not want Pintu to take up the job, Pintu decides to take it up.

videos.title: Pancham's Scared
videos.overview: Murari and Karuna see Pancham throwing a saree. Seeing blood colored stains on the saree, they suspect that Pancham has killed Pintu. Pinky learns about it and arrives to arrest Pancham.

videos.title: The Missing Wig
videos.overview: Pancham is arrested by Pinky. In order to prove Pancham's innocence, Pintu is asked to appear before Pinky. But, Pintu finds that the wig, which he uses to disguise as Pancham's wife, is missing.

videos.title: Elaichi's Plan
videos.overview: Pancham and Pintu are depressed about the way things have turned out in their lives. Their dreams of becoming musicians remain unfulfilled. Hearing this Elaichi comes up with a plan. She disguises as a foreigner and meets Pancham.

videos.title: The Foreign Visitor
videos.overview: Sunita teaches English to Pintu and Elaichi's parents. Elaichi is upset as Pancham is falling for the foreign visitor.

videos.title: Ella's True Identity
videos.overview: Elaichi, dressed up as Ella, calls Pancham and asks him to meet her. Pancham asks Ella if he can accompany her to the hotel. But, Ella avoids the question. Later, Pinky arrives at Murari's shop to arrest Ella.

videos.title: Elaichi's Arrest
videos.overview: Elaichi avoids an imminent arrest by revealing that she pretended to be Ella. Pancham and Murari are shocked. Later, Elaichi is furious at Pancham for flirting with Ella.

videos.title: Marriage Certificate
videos.overview: Pinky pays a surprise visit to Murari's house. He asks Pancham and Pintu for their marriage certificate. Pancham manages to convince Pinky that he will provide the certificate the next day.

videos.title: Pancham and Pintu's Marriage
videos.overview: Elaichi, with the help of her friend, conducts Pancham and Pintu's marriage photo shoot. Later, Pinky arrives to get his hands on the evidence which should prove that Pancham and Pintu are married.

videos.title: The Bomb
videos.overview: Pancham and Pintu arrive in Elaichi's room and inform her that they have found a bomb. Together they decide to dispose off the bomb before they are caught. Meanwhile, Murari sees Chatanki carrying a briefcase. Believing that Chatanki is stealing his briefcase, Murari beats up Chatanki.

videos.title: The Briefcase
videos.overview: The confusion over the briefcase continues as Murari fights with Chatanki over the briefcase. Seeing the briefcase, Pancham presumes that it is the one that contains the bomb. Pinky arrives and takes matters into his hands and tries to diffuse the bomb.

videos.title: Elaichi's Mission
videos.overview: Elaichi wants to teach a lesson to those who urinate in public. She starts bursting firecrackers whenever someone is found urinating in the open. Even Pancham is not spared by Elaichi.

videos.title: Pancham Joins The Mission
videos.overview: Officer Pinkiy complains that Elaichi had lit firecrackers at him while he was on his duty. Later Elaichi convinces Pancham to join him on her rally against public urination.

videos.title: The Public Toilet
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham disguise as press reporters and question Netaji about the public toilet construction in the area. Netaji is caught off guard as he has converted the toilet in Murari's house into a public toilet. Now, Netaji has no choice but to construct a public toilet.

videos.title: Cctv In Action
videos.overview: Elaichi wants to take Pancham out for a movie but he is denying Elaichi's offer. Murari is installing security cameras in his home and shop.

videos.title: Who's The Thief
videos.overview: Murari sees Elaichi going to Pancham's house in the CCTV camera. Later, the CCTV footage reveals a thief stealing money from Murari's locker in his shop. As the thief's face is covered, Murari is unable to find out the identity of the thief.

videos.title: The Ghost
videos.overview: Pinky sneaks into Murari's shop and steals money from the locker. Murari returns to the shop and after checking the locker finds some money missing. The CCTV footage reveals the identity of the culprit but Pinky claims that he stole the money to test Murari.

videos.title: The Witch's Demand
videos.overview: Murari is convinced that the witch in his house is stealing his money, but the real plot twists when the witch asks for the CCTV cameras to be removed.

videos.title: A Dream or a Nightmare
videos.overview: Murari spots a thief stealing from his store at night. Elaichi gets a dream that Pancham and Pintu are leaving for Dubai for a job. Next morning Elaichi is forced to think that she might have to live without Pancham.

videos.title: Dubai Trip
videos.overview: Elaichi refuses to come to Dubai along with her family. Murari starts to miss Chhote. When the final formalities are to be done, Elaichi refuses to sign the papers.

videos.title: Trips Around The World
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi dresses up as a Sheikhs and visits Murari's shop. Murari cancels the Dubai trip and plans to settle in New Zeeland, but eventually all of the trips are cancelled and Murari finds Chandni Chowk to be his best fit.

videos.title: The Lottery Ticket
videos.overview: Chatanki has started a new business, he is now selling lottery tickets. Elaichi forces Pancham to buy a lottery ticket even though Pancham is not optimistic about winning. Later, Pancham discovers to his surprise that he has own the lottery.

videos.title: Pancham's Bad Luck
videos.overview: Pancham leaves his job after finding out that he has won the lottery. When he arrives at the office, he discovers that the lottery ticket was a scam. Pancham returns to Murari in hope of getting the job back.

videos.title: The Roles are Reversed
videos.overview: This time Pancham is the woman and Pintu is the man. Pancham and Pintu dress up as couples and crates a scene in front of Murari. Pancham gets the chance to become the hero and it impresses Murari.

videos.title: Trip to Manali
videos.overview: Murari is worried about the decreasing profit margin. In a drastic change, Murari sponsors Pancham and Pintu's trip to Manali. Elaichi is suspicious of Murari's sponsorship as she believes Murari has a hidden agenda.

videos.title: Pancham's Dilemma
videos.overview: Elaichi makes a threatening phone call to Pancham by disguising her voice. She asks Pancham not to go to Manali to avoid dire consequences. Pancham informs Murari that he and Pintu cannot go to Manali but Murari is adamant that Pancham will go to Manali at the earliest.

videos.title: Pancham's Ghost
videos.overview: Pinky manages to get back his job, which ends his humiliation at the hands of Murari. Later, Murari learns that the flight in which Pancham and Pintu were coming from Manali met with an accident. When Chatanki goes to sleep in the room, he finds Pancham and Pintu and understands them to be the ghosts.

videos.title: The Return Of Pancham and Pintu
videos.overview: Murari inspects Pancham and Pintu's room after Chatanki claims that he saw them. Pancham and Pintu return the next day and claim that they survived the plane crash. But, a news delivered by Karuna exposes their lies.

videos.title: Summer is Here
videos.overview: The summer heat is depleting the joys out of Pancham, Murari, and his family's lives. Pancham decides to buy a packet of chips. This turns out to be his lucky day as in a lucky draw he is declared the winner of an air cooler.

videos.title: Air Cooler
videos.overview: Pancham is ecstatic that he has own an air cooler. Murari plays spoilsport by informing Pancham that he will keep the air cooler for himself. Elaichi decides to ruin Murari's plan by making sure the air cooler belongs to Pancham.

videos.title: Pinky's Discovery
videos.overview: Murari is clueless about the identity of the air cooler thief, unaware that the cooler is providing much-needed relief to Pancham and Pintu. Pinky happens to enter Pintu's room by mistake and sees the air cooler.

videos.title: Murari's Generosity
videos.overview: Elaichi manages to bring the good out of Murari and convinces him to get the air cooler from Pinky, who has stolen it from Pintu. When Murari goes to the police station to get the air cooler, the machine blasts due to a malfunction. Then, Murari decides to buy an air cooler for Pancham.

videos.title: Goodwill Thief
videos.overview: Elaichi steals money from Muraris locker. Then, Chatanki and Karuna sneak into the shop to keep some money in the locker. Murari sees the two and presumes they are stealing money. When the blame is put on Pancham, Elaichi reveals the reason for stealing money.

videos.title: Murari Goes to Sleep
videos.overview: It is Jagrata time and everyone is preparing for the devotional night. During the Jagrata, Murari falls asleep. The singer is quite irritated and threatens to leave unless Murari makes an apology. Elaichi asks her father not to apologies and informs the singer that she will sing along with her father.

videos.title: Lip Syncing
videos.overview: While Pancham is helping Murari learn singing, people gather around the shop and beat up Murari after hearing his cacophonous voice. Then, Elaichi gets a new plan to make Murari sing. She plans to make Murari lip sync while Pancham sings in the background.

videos.title: The Death Threat
videos.overview: Pancham decides to leave the house after being asked to sing in Jagrata. Murari threatens to commit suicide if Pancham leaves. Finally, Pancham yields and agrees to sing in the Jagrata.

videos.title: Faith
videos.overview: Chatanki dresses up as a tiger to save Murari from humiliation. But, before he can roar like a tiger, he is tranquilized. Elaichi believes the Goddess will answer her call and the tiger will appear. Elaichis faith prevails and a tiger really appears.

videos.title: The Tale Of a Mermaid
videos.overview: Murari is irritated by the simmering heat and the lack of water supply. Meanwhile, Elaichi overhears Pancham talking about mermaids. She decides to become one and informs Pancham that she is a mermaid.

videos.title: The Search For Water
videos.overview: Pinky approaches Chhote and asks to give him some water so that he can sprinkle the precious liquid on the vegetables. Meanwhile, Pancham and Pintu come to know that Chote has a bucket of water. Due to severe water shortage, Pancham decides to steal the bucket of water so that Elaichi, who is pretending to be a mermaid, can live.

videos.title: Fight For Water
videos.overview: Pancham informs Elaichi that he has managed to arrange water for her. Elaichi is seen by Chatanki wasting water when it is scarce. Later, Pancham, Pintu, Murari and his family fight for water and a chance to take bath first.

videos.title: Mermaid In Distress
videos.overview: Pinky suspects the Chote has stolen a bucket of water from his police station and arrives to arrest him. Meanwhile, a crook sees Elaichi dressed as a mermaid and thinks she is really a mermaid. When the crook tries to kidnap Elaichi, Pancham stands up for her.

videos.title: Murari's Life In Danger
videos.overview: Murari learns that his life is in danger. Meanwhile, Pancham sees a stack of notes on the ground and picks it up, unaware that he is being watched. As soon as he picks up the notes, Mangi Lal nabs him. Elaichi, who is watching this closely, steps forward to help Pancham.

videos.title: Pancham's Plan
videos.overview: Pancham contemplates that he is unworthy of Elaichi's respect and decides to become a bad man in front of her. Elaichi sees Pancham stealing money from the locker and wonders whats wrong with him. Meanwhile, Murari overhears Karuna and Chatankis conversation and thinks the two are trying to kill him.

videos.title: Elaichi's Heartbreak
videos.overview: Elaichi reads a love letter written by Pancham. She is heartbroken after finding out that Pancham is having an affair. Meanwhile, Murari is worried that his wife has conspired with her brother to kill him. To share his grief, he goes to Chote's barbershop.

videos.title: Pinky's Time is Up
videos.overview: Chatanki decides to rename the rat as Pinky instead of Murari. While Chatanki is discussing ways to kill the rat with Karuna, Pinky arrives. After overhearing their conversation, Pinky presumes that he is Chatanki's next target.

videos.title: Rest In Peace
videos.overview: Murari overhears Karuna and Chatanki's conversation and presumes that they have killed Pinky. He follows them along with Mangi Lal and busts them. Karuna informs Murari that they have killed a rat, which was named Pinky, and not Pinky himself. An infuriated Karuna leaves Murari with Chatanki. Now, Murari has to win over Karuna.

videos.title: The Rodents
videos.overview: A dupe in the disguise of a customer gets into Murari's shop and sets free a bunch of rats. Now the drama starts, as the whole house plus the shop gets infested with the little furry creatures.

videos.title: Cat Attack
videos.overview: There is a criminal in town dressed up as a cat. Surprisingly Elaichi wants Pancham to wear a cat costume and drive the rats away. The mix and match between the two cats make a mess.

videos.title: Cat Man The Criminal
videos.overview: As the criminal Billi Man, who is dressed up as a cat, goes around the neighborhood troubling everyone, inspector Pinky tries to catch him. But, instead, he gets into trouble himself. Pancham is still in the cat costume and a bad case of mix and match awaits!

videos.title: Catching The Cat
videos.overview: Pinky blames Pancham for kidnapping Elaichi. In order to come clean, Pancham proclaims that he will free Elaichi from the kidnapper. After Elaichi is finally freed, a new challenge is thrown at Pancham.

videos.title: Self-defence
videos.overview: Elaichi plans to open a self-defense class for all the women of Chandi Chowk. Pancham helps her out by being the instructor. More fun awaits in this episode.

videos.title: Pepper Sprayed
videos.overview: While training self-defense to girls, Pancham becomes a victim when a girl puts pepper spray on him. Meanwhile, Chatanki disguises himself as God and appears before Murari. The act does not last long and Murari finds out that Chatanki took him for a ride.

videos.title: Taking a Stand
videos.overview: Elaichi learns that women are being eve-teased by men in the locality. Elaichi decides to teach the men a lesson. The eve-teasers are enraged when Elaichi punishes them for their actions and decide to retaliate by going after her father. Murari is forced to wear a burqa to escape the attackers.

videos.title: Proud Father
videos.overview: Elaichi manages to teach a lesson to Munna, who was eve-teasing passersby. Elaichi is honored for her bravery, which makes Murari proud. Later, Murari falls unconscious after a session at the barber.

videos.title: Weight Loss
videos.overview: Murari learns that he has to eat healthy in order to stay healthy. Elaichi plans a strict diet for Murari and forces him to follow it. Meanwhile, Pinky is on a weight loss program of his own as he fears that he will be fired if he doesn't lose the extra kilos.

videos.title: The Diet Plans
videos.overview: There is mess going on and it's on nothing but food. Officer Pinki just can't refuse good food while his doctor said no, and Murari puts Pancham on the spot.

videos.title: Pancham's Heart Attack
videos.overview: Whenever Elaichi is about to catch Murari red handed eating sweets, Murari claims innocence and blames Pancham of trying to spoil him. Pancham has a plan to defeat Murari at his own game and fakes a heart attack to scare Murari. Elaichi sees Panchams medical report and warns Murari that he too will suffer a similar fate if he does not mend his ways.

videos.title: Murari's Angel
videos.overview: The doctor informs Murari that he has lost weight and saved himself from an apparent death. Murari is emotional after learning that Elaichi concealed from him the fact that he had only a few days to live. Later, Murari shares his grief about his falling hair with Chote, who gives a magic oil to restore Murari's hair.

videos.title: Hair Loss Secret
videos.overview: Pancham applies a lotion to Murari's hair. Instead of helping Murari gain hair, the lotion makes Murari bald. Murari blames Chote, who gave him the lotion. But, Chote claims that Pancham has a hand in Murari's hair loss. Murari seeks revenge and wants Pancham to go bald as well.

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: Murari drags Pancham to Chotes shop and gets his head clean shaved. Meanwhile, Raka escapes from custody and comes across Pinky and Chote, who are at the receiving end of Rakas punishment. Then, Pinky and Chote inform Murari about the madman Raka.

videos.title: Madman On The Run
videos.overview: Raka has instilled fear in the hearts of Pinky, Chote, and Murari, who are all bald. Chatanki decides to exploit this fear and blackmails Murari in the name of Raka to make a quick buck. Later, Mangilal comes across Raka and informs him about Pinky, who has worn a helmet to hide his bald head from the madman.

videos.title: The Bald Guys
videos.overview: As all the four guys lose their hair and lament and regret, officer Pinki comes up with an idea to catch the real culprit behind this crime. Pancham and Elaichi make a new mess as usual and Murari's fury remains evident in all of this.

videos.title: Elaichi's Challenge
videos.overview: Elaichi breaks another cell phone and Murari to teach her the value of money, refuses to buy her a new one. So Elaichi takes it upon her ego and challenges to open a lehnga store of her own. Officer Pinki disguises as a woman to catch the famous smuggler JK.

videos.title: The Grand Opening
videos.overview: Elaichi opens her lehnga showroom just in front of her father's shop and all the women customers visit her shop. Murari Ji doesn't make a sale for the entire day, so Elaichi offers him money to buy his shop.

videos.title: Elaichi's Offer
videos.overview: Elaichi offers to buy Muraris dwindling business but Murari, not the one to quit easily, asks Elaichi to pay Rs 1 crore and buy the business. Later, Murari sets a new target for Pancham in order to increase sales.

videos.title: The Competition
videos.overview: The competition between Elaichi and his father continues as both of them try to make sure that all the customers rush to their shops. Murari starts giving huge discounts to the customers to sell but Elaichi comes through with a plan to tackle that.

videos.title: Is Elaichi's Marriage On The Cards?
videos.overview: While the war between Murari and Elaichi comes to a peaceful end, Pancham manages to save his job. During a routine massage at Chotes barber shop, Murari is advised by his trusted barber that he should look for an NRI as a bridegroom for Elaichis marriage.  Murari agrees as an NRI son-in-law will mean a  new business venture in a foreign land.

videos.title: A Visit From an Old Friend
videos.overview: Pancham and Pintus friend Jassi, who has settled in the US, gets in touch with his old friends after a long time. Jassi is invited by Pancham and Pintu to meet them at Murari's house. Upon arrival, Jassi sees Pintu and gets surprised.  Pancham barely manages to save his big lie from being revealed to Murari by Jassi.

videos.title: Nri Bridegroom
videos.overview: Elaichi informs Murari that she is ready to marry but the bridegroom has to be an NRI. Then, Elaichi starts flirting with Jassi, to make Pancham jealous. She then meets her friends and informs them that her father is forcefully getting her married to Jassi. Elaichi's friends beat up Jassi in a fit of rage and Jassi presumes that Pancham is behind the attack.

videos.title: The Marriage Proposal
videos.overview: Murari wants Elachi to get married and Elaichi has also agreed to it but she wishes to marry an NRI so Murari Ji gives Panchams NRI friend Jassi a proposal to marry Elachi. Realising what Murari is up to, Pancham gets jealous and plans to kick Jassi out of his way.

videos.title: Drunk In Sorrow
videos.overview: Pancham gets drunk in sorrow because of the talks of Elaichi and Jassi's marriage and almost blurts out his feelings fro Elaichi. Jassi brings home his fake father to talk to Murari Ji about his marriage to Elachi but Pancham has a different plan in his mind.

videos.title: Murari's Fate
videos.overview: Elaichi proves that Jassi isnt an NRI but a thug, who is wanted by the police. Later, Murari comes to know that someone very close to him will leave him. Murari keeps on guessing about the person but isnt sure of the identity of the dear one who will desert him.

videos.title: The Fight Continues
videos.overview: The quarrel between Pancham and Elaichi continues because of Elaichi's remarks. Pancham gets so offended that he decides to leave his job and Murari's house. Murari tries to stop him from doing so and gets emotional. On the other hand, Mangi Lal gives Pinki Ji his resignation letter.

videos.title: Pancham is Fired
videos.overview: Pancham insults Murari in front of the customers and Murari fires Pancham in a fit of rage. Pancham manages to find a job at Chote's barber shop. Meanwhile, Sunita is upset with Elaichi as Pintu left the house. Elaichi informs Sunita that she will teach Pancham a lesson.

videos.title: The Plan
videos.overview: After Pancham leaves Murari's job and the house, he starts working at Chote's barber shop and confronts Murari when he comes to the shop. Sunita and Pintu Bhabhi plan to re-unite Pancham and Elaichi.

videos.title: Mangi Ji Returns
videos.overview: Pinki Ji is devastated after Mangi Ji resigned so he decides to find Mangi Ji and get him back. Sunita and Neetu Bhabi's plan to get Pancham and Elaichi back together doesn't work. Pancham also gets fired from his new job at Chote Barber after an incident lead by Elaichi.

videos.title: Pray For The Rain
videos.overview: Elaichi wants the rain God to shower some rain so that she can dance in the rain. Pancham mocks Elaichi when she proclaims that her prayers will be answered and it will rain. Pancham is proved wrong as Elaichi's prayers are answered and it rains cats and dogs.

videos.title: Weather Report
videos.overview: The weather forecast predicts intense rains in the city and Chatanki uses this as an opportunity to camp in Murari's house. The astrologer predicts that Murari will die due to drowning but doesn't disclose this to Murari. Later, Murari learns from the radio that the river Yamuna will flood the area.

videos.title: The Flood
videos.overview: The entire city is flooded and to escape a watery grave, Murari and his family are staying in Pancham's house. Amidst the chaos, Mangi Lal sees an opportunity to rob Pinky of his money. While Pinky tries to learn swimming, Mangi Lal robs Pinky right under his nose.

videos.title: Raining Cats and Dogs
videos.overview: It's raining cats and dogs in Chandani Chowk and the entire area is submerged under water, so just seeing the opportunity, Elaichi and Pancham go on a romantic boat ride together. Murari visits his bank locker with Chote to get some documents, but gets locked in the locker room.

videos.title: Mission Murari
videos.overview: After Elaichi gets to know that Murari and Chote are trapped inside the bank locker where the water level is rising every minute, she decides to go on a mission to save her father. Pancham also decides to help her save her father and Chote.

videos.title: Agent Elaichi
videos.overview: Murari is saddened as Elaichis failure to pass the exams has brought him shame. To make her father proud, Elaichi decides to pose as an undercover cop. Elaichi saves Murari from a goon and to prove that she is a cop, takes a picture with the minister. Murari believes that Elaichi is a special officer and feels proud.

videos.title: The New Cop In Town
videos.overview: The news that Elaichi is an undercover police officer spreads like wildfire, thanks to Murari. Using the new found respect in her father's eyes to her advantage, Elaichi makes sure that Pancham gets a salary hike. Chote learns about Elaichi's new job and decides to inform Pinky.

videos.title: Kidnapping
videos.overview: After Elaichi's Mama Ji gets kidnapped and her father asks her to rescue him, she is forced to reveal the truth to everyone. Elaichi feels the disappointment in Murari's eyes and decides to rescue her mama Ji herself. Pancham also decides to help Elaichi in the rescue mission.

videos.title: Three Magical Words
videos.overview: Elaichi and Sunita propose to Pancham and Pintu but it turns out they were only pulling their legs. Later, Chatanki is searching for a bride, but his attempts fail as no girl wants to marry him. Then, Murari gets a call from Pancham's mother.Elaichi and Sunita propose to Pancham and Pintu but it turns out they were only pulling their legs. Later, Chatanki is searching for a bride, but his attempts fail as no girl wants to marry him. Then, Murari gets a call from Pancham's mother.

videos.title: The Photoshoot
videos.overview: Pancham's mother gets to know about his marriage, so to dodge her, Pancham convinces Elaichi to have a photoshoot with him, so that he can convince his mother that he married a beautiful girl. Chatanki Chacha receives a marriage proposal after he uploads his photos on a matrimonial site.

videos.title: Surprise, Surprise
videos.overview: Hell breaks loose when Pancham's mother gives him a surprise visit in Murari's house to meet her daughter-in-law. Pancham tries to hide the truth and makes his mother believe that Elaichi is his wife.

videos.title: Favourite Daughter
videos.overview: Murari and Karuna learn that Pancham's mother believes Elaichi to be her daughter-in-law. Pancham takes Murari outside and convinces him that Elaichi is only acting as his wife to please his mother. Later, Chatanki expresses displeasure for not getting married. Pancham's mother asks Pintu to get married to Chatanki.

videos.title: Pintu's Suitors
videos.overview: Chatanki wants to separate Pancham and Pintu, so that he can marry Pintu. Pinky learns about it and decides to persuade Pancham's mother to let him marry Pintu. There is a third suitor for Pintu and it is Chote, who also dreams of marrying Pintu.

videos.title: Choose The Groom
videos.overview: Pancham's mother comes to his room to give Elaichi some sweet but finds Murari sleeping in their room. Pintu has to choose her new husband out of the three suitors i.e. Chatanki, Chote, and Pinki Ji but to avoid this, Elaichi has a foolproof plan to save the day.

videos.title: The Conspiracy
videos.overview: Elaichi's science professor approaches Murari and tells him that Elaichi missed her science exam so Murari punishes her and sends her to the professor's house for tuitions. Pinki Ji is assigned to a case of a terrorist conspiracy and somehow Elaichi's professor and his secret formula get involved in the conspiracy.

videos.title: The Invisibility Cloak
videos.overview: Elaichi gets her hands on an invisibility cloak., which she uses to create mischief. Pancham, Murari, and Pintu are troubled by an invisible force, unaware that Elaichi is behind the mischief.

videos.title: Adventures Of Bijli
videos.overview: Terrorist Black Cobra kidnaps Elaichi's science professor and tortures him to surrender his invisibility cloak's formula, which is actually in Elaichi's possession right now. Elaichi uses the invisibility cloak to save people in her society.

videos.title: Bijli Hindustani's New Mission
videos.overview: Bijli Hindustani AKA Elaichi gets her next mission when she hears the news of a famous and expensive statue being stolen and smuggled outside the country. So she decides to the stop the smuggle in-between. Black Cobra gets to know about Bijli Hindustani saving people using the invisibility cloak.

videos.title: Pancham is Kidnapped
videos.overview: Bijli Hindustani aka Elaichi has a lot of fun with Murari and Pancham being invisible. She even makes Murari give money to Pancham. Later Black Cobra's men hear Pancham talking to Bijli Hindustani in the market so they kidnap Pancham in order to lure Bijli Hindustani.

videos.title: Bijli Saves The Day
videos.overview: Bijli Hindustani reaches in the den of terrorist Black Cobra just in time and saves Pancham from getting killed. She later reveals herself as Elaichi to her family and also returns the invisibility cloak to the army chief. Later Murari with his wife and brother-in-law goes to visit his plot to perform a puja where the next trouble is waiting for them.

videos.title: Getting The Land Back
videos.overview: Murari with his wife and Chatanki goes to check up on his land which he bought through Inspector Pinki Ji, but when he gets there, he comes to know that his land has been encroached upon by a builder named Khanna. When even Pinki Ji refuses to help them get their land back in fear of Khanna builder, Chatanki comes up with a plan.

videos.title: A New Plan
videos.overview: Chatanki's plan to get back the property by force didn't work as he gets beaten up badly by Khanna's men. Murari is devastated by the thought of losing his property, so Elaichi decides to get back the property not by brawn but by brain and comes up with a plan to fool Khanna.

videos.title: Meet Hina Quereshi
videos.overview: Meet Humza Qureshi and Hina Qureshi aka Pancham and Elaichi, who disguised as a businessman from Dubai, who wants to sell their big chunk of land. Elaichi's plan works as Builder Khanna agrees to meet the rich party of Dubai. But during their meeting, something happens which puts Elaichi and Pancham in great trouble.

videos.title: Elaichi's Ingenious Plan
videos.overview: Khanna demands to see the property but Elaichi is unsure how she will find a plot of land. Elaichi's friend, Sanju comes to the rescue. The land in the name of Sanju's father is used by Elaichi to lure Khanna.

videos.title: The Plan is Successful
videos.overview: Elaichi's plan to trick Khanna and get the land back is successful, after they get the entire amount for the fake land in cash. Pinki Ji finds out about the entire charade and still supports Murari's family. All seems well now for Pancham and everyone else but what they don't know is that another trouble is headed their way.

videos.title: Wedding Bells?
videos.overview: Panchami Ji calls Pancham and asks him to send the wedding pictures of him and Elaichi, but Pancham lies to her that the wedding album got burned in a house fire. Chatanki informs Murari and his wife that he has seen an amazing guy for Elaichi to marry and Elaichi decides to meet him to make Pancham jealous.

videos.title: Elaichi's Marriage
videos.overview: Pancham congratulates Elaichi as she is getting married in a reputed family. Things turn turtle when Pancham's mother pays a surprise visit. Pancham's mother believes Elaichi is her daughter-in-law, but Murari is getting Elaichi married.

videos.title: Pancham is Terror
videos.overview: Panchami Ji is back in the house and wanst Pancham and Elaichi to get married once again so that she has some good pictures of their marriage to flaunt to her friends and relatives but she becomes furious after seeing Murari trying to get Elaichi married to the Inspectors son.

videos.title: The Trouble Continues
videos.overview: Pancham gets relaxed gets enough time on his hands to plan his next move after Panchami Ji decides to go to Haridwar for a couple of days but things go sideways when Panchami Ji decides to come back from the trip halfway with a Pandit to get Pancham and Elaichi married.

videos.title: Wedding Blues
videos.overview: Murari and Karuna are worried as Elaichi is getting married to Pancham. Elaichi makes her parents understand the wedding is taking place only to please Panchams mother. Later, Chote gatecrashes the wedding and reveals to Panchams mother that Pancham and Pintu are married.

videos.title: The Suspicion
videos.overview: Pancham sees Karuna with a child and presumes that the child is Karunas daughter. Murari is on the verge of transferring the ownership of his properties to Karuna. Pancham tries to stop the transfer of ownership but in vain. Later, Pinky gets the shock of his life when he discovers that he and Chote are brothers.

videos.title: Elaichi's Investigation
videos.overview: Pancham informs Pintu that he saw Karuna with a child. Meanwhile, Elaichi also suspects the same and decides to When Karuna sneaks out of the house at night, Elaichi follows her and what she sees leaves her shocked.

videos.title: Stealing The Money
videos.overview: Pancham confronts Muraris wife about her escapades during the night and she tells her the truth and asks him to steal some money from Muraris shop to help her. Elaichi tells Murari about her mother having another daughter and Murari is devastated so they both follow her mother to the lodge the same night.

videos.title: Catching Pancham
videos.overview: Murari is devastated after he finds out about his wife having another daughter. Elaichi eavesdrop on Pancham and the mother's conversation about stealing more money from Murari's vault, so she plans with Murari to catch Pancham red-handed.

videos.title: The Truth is Out
videos.overview: After Elaichi and Murari catch Pancham stealing the money red-handing, Pancham and Muraris wife tell them the truth behind the charade. A dancer comes to the society for her dance show and everyone is head over heels to catch a glimpse of her.

videos.title: The Blackmail
videos.overview: Elaichi starts blackmailing Pancham with the video she has of stealing Muraris samosa and asks him to propose her and just when he is proposing her, Chatanki Mama sees him. Chote Barbar takes Murari to watch the dance show with him by lying to him.

videos.title: The Newly Weds
videos.overview: Karuna sees Elaichi with Pancham and gets startled. Elaichi lies to Karuna but Chatanki puts an end to the drama. Pancham has had enough of Elaichi's drama and wants it to end as soon as possible.

videos.title: Blackmailing
videos.overview: Kallu Chamans terror leads Murari to give her the blackmail money so he seeks the help of Inspector Pinki only to find out that Kallu Chaman has been blackmailing him too. When Elaichi finds out about the entire charade, she decides to take Pancham's help in putting an end to this.

videos.title: The Showdown
videos.overview: The situation at Muraris house is still tensed as his wife decides to kick him out of the house. Elaichi plans to confront Kallo Chaman, get their money back and put an end to the entire charade.

videos.title: The Stranger
videos.overview: Pancham calls up Kallo Chaman and asks her to reveal the truth to Pinky. As the Kallo Chaman saga ends, another one begins. A woman sneaks into Elaichis house at midnight. Later, Pancham finds a stranger in Murari's house and presuming that he is a thief, beats him up.

videos.title: Mom to The Rescue
videos.overview: Murari has decided to adopt Pancham. When he informs Elaichi about it, she presumes that Murari wants her to marry Pancham. The plot takes a twist when Murari clarifies about his intention to adopt Pancham. Now, Elaichi and Pancham have to find a way to stop the adoption.

videos.title: The Adoption Conundrum
videos.overview: Murari is adamant about adopting Pancham and Elaichi is adamant about not letting it happen. Someone is keeping an eye on Elaichi and doing some kind of black magic. Chote, Pinki Ji, and others try to convince Murari to adopt them.

videos.title: Thug Life
videos.overview: Murari somehow convinces Panchami Ji to agree with him for adopting Pancham, so Elaichi comes up with a foolproof plan to get Pancham out of the situation. She asks Pancham to act like the worst son ever, so that Murari changes his mind about adopting him.

videos.title: Murari's Grades
videos.overview: Pancham manages to avoid getting adopted by Murari by pretending to be the worst son ever. In a fit of rage, Murari fires Pancham. Elaichi intervenes and reveals that Pancham did the bad deeds as per her orders. Later, Elaichi finds out that Murari failed in his exams and reveals the news to her family members.

videos.title: Back to School
videos.overview: After Elaichi finds out that Murari doesnt hold a Masters degree and he failed in school. she takes it upon herself to make him complete his studies so she takes him to her school.

videos.title: Elaichi is Furious
videos.overview: Elaichi is mad at Pancham for dissing her the previous day so she starts ignoring him even after he buys bangles for her. She even makes him jealous by going to the movies with Sanju. Chatanki witnesses Pancham beating up Pintu and goes to the police station to Pinki Ji to file an FIR against Pancham for the count of domestic violence.

videos.title: Murari Goes to School
videos.overview: Murari goes to school along with Elaichi and gets embarrassed as the students mock him for being old. Later, Chatanki and Karuna presume that Pancham is beating Pintu. Karuna calls up Pinky and informs him about the domestic violence going on in her house.

videos.title: Elaichi's Strictness
videos.overview: After the embarrassment in the school, Elaichi is adamant on making Murari continue his studies so when Chote taunts Murari in his shop Elaichi decides to teach him herself for the upcoming exam.

videos.title: Results are Out
videos.overview: Pancham steals the question paper from the school to help Murari pass the exam but Elaichi tears the question paper apart as she wants Murari to pass the exam on his own merit. So the day of the exam comes and Murari is petrified.

videos.title: The End Of The World
videos.overview: A woman arrives at Muraris shop and seeks a job. Elaichi forces Murari to hire the woman as the new cook. Meanwhile, a TV news reporter nervously reads the breaking news- a comet is on a collision course with the earth.  Murari watches the news and fears that the end is near.

videos.title: Doomsday is Near
videos.overview: Fearing that its the end of the world Elaichi and Sunnu decide to confess their feelings for Pancham and Pintu. Pancham and Pintu also plan to ask Elaichi and Sunnus fathers what they want.

videos.title: Doomsday Postponed
videos.overview: Just when Pancham decides to express his love for Elaichi to Murari in the fear of the doomsday, America launches missiles to destroy the meteorite on the way. Due to this, Pancham changes his mind which makes Elaichi furious.

videos.title: The Proposal
videos.overview: Pancham and Pintu have decided to propose to their respective lady love before the doomsday. Pancham gathers the courage to tell Murari that he is in love Elaichi. Pintu too asks for Sunitas hand in marriage from her father. But, the reactions turn out to be quite different from what Pancham and Pintu had hoped for.

videos.title: The Coward
videos.overview: Murari has been hiding a secret for decades. Karuna finds out to her dismay that Murari has been branded a coward.  Elaichi also finds out about her fathers secret and decides to erase the stigma from her fathers name.

videos.title: Making Murari Brave
videos.overview: Elaichi is devastated after she finds out Muraris secret being revealed to everyone and him being stamped as a coward so she decides to take Pancham to make Murari brave again.

videos.title: Plan After Plan
videos.overview: Elaichis every plan seems to be flopping as she is not able to trigger Muraris brave self. She even calls Pancham a coward for not going with Murari to the morgue so Pancham tries to redeem himself.

videos.title: Problem Solved
videos.overview: Elaichi asks Pancham to disguise as a  goon and go to Muraris shop and ask him for extortion money in order to trigger Muraris brave side. After two attempts, the plan works as Murari beat Pancham disguised as a goon. But the thrill is just not over yet for Elaichi as Murari gets kidnapped the same night.

videos.title: The Replacement
videos.overview: Murari gets abducted by his doppelganger and the doppelganger enters his house pretending to be Murari. At the start, everything seems fine but then Pancham catches Murari's doppelganger doing something he would never do.

videos.title: The Fake One
videos.overview: The fake Murari is inside the house and tries to find the locker where the real Murari keeps all his money. Elaichi feels that her father is behaving a little odd but doesnt do anything about it. Pancham and Pintu see the fake Murari hugging the lady helper and decide to tell Elaichi about it.

videos.title: Finding The Locker
videos.overview: Elaichi feels that something weird is going on with Murari and decides to find the truth behind it. Pancham is devastated after Murari informs everyone that he has decided to marry Elaichi to Mahendra.

videos.title: Saving Murari Bansal
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham make a plan to catch the fake Murari and save the real one so Elaichi asks him to sing the song which he used to sing to her in her childhood. Elaichi and Pancham follow him to the place where the real Murari is kept tied down.

videos.title: The Truth Serum
videos.overview: Elaichi wants Pancham to say out his feelings out loud to her so she tries to get him to say how he feels. Murari sells a cheap Lehnga for a lot of money to Chote. Elaichi finds out about Pinki Ji in possession of a truth serum and decides to use it on Pancham.

videos.title: The After Effects
videos.overview: Chote who wanted to inject the truth serum to Murariwhich was given to him by Pinki Ji, injects it in Pancham by mistake and as a result, Pancham starts speaking nothing but the truth. Things go sideways when Pancham expresses his love for Elaichi in front of Murari.

videos.title: Keeping Pancham Away
videos.overview: Pancham is again injected by the truth serum by Chote and when Murari gets to know about this he decides to keep Pancham tied up in his room to keep him away from Chote.

videos.title: Maintain Distance
videos.overview: Elaichi is given the task to keep Pancham away from Chote by Murari so she takes him to the movies to keep him occupied until the truth serum wears off. But the problem arises when Chote follows them to the theatre and reaches there.

videos.title: Test Of Love
videos.overview: As Muraris wife gets involved in an accident, police come to arrest her but Murari takes all the blame on himself to save his wife. Witnessing the love between her parents, Elaichi decides to test Panchams love for her.

videos.title: Elaichi's Not So Foolproof Plan
videos.overview: Elaichi sneaks out of her house to go to a friends party with the help of Pancham but later she comes back running to Pancham claiming that she got mugged and the theif took all her mothers jewelry that she was wearing.

videos.title: Elaichi In Trouble
videos.overview: Elaichi takes it too far this time after she hides her mothers jewelry and claims to Pancham that she got mugged. So when Chote asks Murari to lend him some jewelry for his sisters wedding, urari is not able to help him. Things get even worse when Elaichi is not able to find the jewelry at the place where she hid it.

videos.title: Retrieving The Jewelry
videos.overview: Pinki Ji comes to Muraris house to investigate the missing jewelry and finds the missing bangles in Panchams room. So Murari gives Pancham the ultimatum to give him the jewelry by the end of the day. Elaichi feels that Pancham was framed so she takes charge of the situation.

videos.title: The Nightmare
videos.overview: Elaichi has a nightmare in which she saw Panchams death. In order to protect Pancham from bad omen, Elaichi decides to keep a fast. Murari comes to know that Elaichi is fasting for someone.

videos.title: Elaichi Fasts For Pancham
videos.overview: Elaichi keeps a fast for Pancham but when Pancham gets to know about it he makes up a story of how Elaichis life will be threatened if she keeps a fast for him. A gangster against whom Pancham was a witness in the court and who went to jail because of Pancham, gets out of the jail and decides to take his revenge from Pancham.

videos.title: A Lot Of Convincing
videos.overview: Elaichi decides to take Chotes help in making sure that she breaks her fast with Pancham. Pancham tries to convince Elaichi not to continue her fast. Panchami Ji sends Karva Chauth gifts to Pintu. The gangster who got out of the jail tries to find Pancham.

videos.title: Bakhtawar In The House
videos.overview: Elaichi convinces Pancham to act in the Karwa Chauth play, in order to break her fast and Chote helps gathering the funds for the play. Chatanki brings home Bakhtawa, the gangster, who is looking for Pancham.

videos.title: The Sharpshooter
videos.overview: Elaichi believes that she has gotten rid of the death threat on Pancham. During the play, Elaichi decides to break her fast and makes changes to the script while on stage, which leaves Chote surprised. Meanwhile, the sharpshooter has taken the position. He aims the rifle at Pancham while the play is going on.

videos.title: Movie Date
videos.overview: Elaichi saves Pancham from the jaws of death. Pinky arrives at the right time and arrests the sharpshooter. Later, Elaichi plans to go for a movie with Pancham. Knowing that Pancham will not agree to come for the movie, Elaichi calls up Pancham and pretends that she is being kidnapped. Pancham and Pintu make a heroic entry at the theatre to save Elaichi.

videos.title: The New Principal
videos.overview: Elaichi and Sunita are called in the new Principals office for a meeting and they are flabbergasted to see that its the same guy whom they had a beef within the movie theatre. The new Principal asks both of them to bring their fathers for a meeting so they disguise Pancham and Rajesh Khanna as their fathers.

videos.title: The Parent Teacher Meeting
videos.overview: Elaichis professor is about to visit Muraris shop to buy a lehenga and meet Murari so Elaichi sends her father and mother to the movies so that Pancham disguised as Murari meets her professor. But things get series when Murari and his wife come back from the movie theatre while the Pancham and Elaichis professor are at the shop.

videos.title: Diwali is Here
videos.overview: Pancham asks Murari to give him some Diwali bonus to celebrate Diwali and Elaichi pushed forward his demand. Chatanki decides to start a fair trade so he decides to light up the entire Chandni Chowk. Murari decides to play cards with Chote for money but little does he know, that this decision is going to stir up huge problems for him.

videos.title: Playing Cards
videos.overview: Murari plays cards and bets money while playing with Chote and a bunch of people in Chandni Chowk but everyone runs away when Inspector Pinki Ji raids the place. So Murari decides to take everyone to his house to play cards but little does he know, he is going exactly where Pinki Ji wants them to be.

videos.title: Elaichi's Plan
videos.overview: Pinki Ji warns Murari not to continue the cards sessions in his house or he will be forced to stop them his way. Elaichi realizes her fathers bad habits to bet on playing cards so she decides to take Panchams help in the matter.

videos.title: Kharbanda Uncle
videos.overview: Pancham disguised as Kharbanda uncle enters the scene and lures Murari to play cards with him by claiming to be rich and as expected Murari walks into their trap. Muraris wife asks him not to bet anymore in playing cards but he doesnt listen.

videos.title: The Great Gamblers
videos.overview: The gambling continues and Murari is confident that he will be victorious. Pinky has three queens, Murari has three kings but Kharbanda uncle has three aces up his sleeve. The cards are put on the table, and Kharbanda uncle takes away the riches.

videos.title: Getting Mugged
videos.overview: Pancham is given a task by Murari to deposit a sum of money in the bank but when Pancham is on his way to the bank, he is mugged by none other than Chatanki. Pancham tells this story to Elaichi and Pintu so Elaichi comes up with a plan to save Pancham from her fathers wrath.

videos.title: The Memory Loss
videos.overview: Pancham pretends that he has lost his memory but Murari isnt sold on his new act. Murari decides to find out the truth and the whereabouts of the money he gave to Pancham. He informs Pancham that his mother met with an accident. Now, Pancham's reaction will be a tell-tale sign for Murari.

videos.title: New Found Love
videos.overview: Panchams fall renders him unconscious.  What comes next is something Elaichi would never have expected. Pancham loses his memory and beviles that he is someone else. The personality change in Pancham makes Elaichi nervous. Elaichi feels insecure as Pancham starts liking Sunita.

videos.title: Treating The Amnesia
videos.overview: Elaichi is worried about Pancham going after Sunita after he loses his memory because of the fall so she decides to take it upon herself to bring Panchams memory back. On the other side, Murari is also worried about his money that Pancham lost so he has a plan of his own to bring back his memories.

videos.title: The Way to a Mans Heart
videos.overview: Elaichi wants to impress Pancham but isnt sure how. While having a conversation with Pintu, Elaichi learns that Pancham loves delicious food. Elaichi decides to learn cooking and prepare a delicious meal for Pancham in order to impress him.

videos.title: The Royal Feast
videos.overview: Elaichi prepares a royal feast for everyone in her house in order to impress Pancham. Everyone is excited to taste the food prepared by Elaichi but all the excitement goes down the drain when they taste the first bite.

videos.title: Dodging Elaichi
videos.overview: Everyone knows that the food prepared by Elaichi was not desirable so when she decides to prepare the breakfast the next day for everyone, everybody vanishes from the house making excuses. Things go sideways when Elaichi catches them eating outside on the food stalls.

videos.title: The Bad Cook
videos.overview: Elaichi is overwhelmed by the response to her cooking. She prepares a sweet dish and goes around the neighborhood asking people to try it out. Whoever eats the sweets, wishes they ever never born. Elaichi overhears Chote and Muraris conversation and learns that they didnt like her food in the first place.

videos.title: The Honest Cook
videos.overview: Pancham advises Elaichi to take a shortcut and serve food bought from a restaurant to Chote. But, Elaichi doesnt want to cheat and decides to prepare the food herself. Murari is worried and takes Panchams help to implement a plan that will make sure Chote's taste buds are satisfied.

videos.title: Guru Chaturmukh
videos.overview: The Murari household is all set for the arrival of Guru Chaturmukh. Karuna asks Elaichi, Pancham, and Pintu to be present in the house when Guru Chaturmukh arrives. Finally, when Guru Chaturmukh arrives, Murari asks him about Elaichi's marriage.

videos.title: Fortune Teller
videos.overview: Guru Chaturmukh arrives at Bansal house and everyone starts asking him questions about their lives. When Chatanki asks him about his future wife, Chaturmukh asks him to do a huge favor to Pintu in order to turn his life around. Now the question falls on Pancham if hell accept the favor or not.

videos.title: Things Go Sideways
videos.overview: When Pancham and Pintu come across with a difficult decision and are in a dilemma whether to do the right thing and stand back or take a step forward by helping Murari. So Elaichi helps them and comes up with a not so foolproof plan which turns against them.

videos.title: A Family Reunion
videos.overview: A family reunion is on its way for Pintu when Elaichi comes in with Pancham disguised as Pintus mother and two other friends disguised as Pintus father and grandfather. Elaichi plans to change Guru Chaturmukhs mind with their help.

videos.title: The Truth is Out
videos.overview: Pintus wig catches fire and he is forced to remove his wig in front of Elaichi and Sunita. Then, Elaichi creates a scene, pretending that she didnt know of Pintus secret, and threatens to tell Murari about it. Pancham and Pintu manage to convince Elaichi to keep their lie a secret in order to continue their stay.

videos.title: Elaichi's Plan
videos.overview: Elaichi threatens to tell the truth to Murari. Pancham manages to convince Elaichi to keep Pintus truth a secret.  Meanwhile, seeing Pintu and Sunitas blossoming romance, Elaichi feels that Pancham hasnt expressed his feelings for her. In order to force the three magical words out of Pancham, Elaichi comes up with a plan.

videos.title: The Bad News
videos.overview: Pancham meets Sunita and learns that Elaichi is suffering from a serious illness and has only a few days to live. Pancham is heartbroken after hearing this news, unaware that it is a lie. Elaichi pretends like she has only a few days to live so that Pancham can express his feelings to her.

videos.title: Pancham Gets Emotional
videos.overview: Pancham is starting to tear up after he gets to know about Elaichi's illness. So, when Elaichi asks him to go to the movies with her not as her Jijaji but as her friend, he couldn't say no. Chatanki's horse lending business seems to be working after Chote rents a horse for his wedding.

videos.title: Elaichi's Wishes
videos.overview: Elaichi's professor comes to her house to complain about her to Murari. Pancham gets furious at him and confronts him. Pancham overhears Elaichi expressing her wishes to Sunita so he decides to fulfill her wishes anyhow.

videos.title: Three Magic Words
videos.overview: As Elaichi is frustrated with Pancham for not expressing his feelings for her, Pancham has his own plan going on, as he steals the horse which Chote is supposed to ride to his marriage function. Pancham rides the horse to Elaichi's house and expresses his feelings to her.

videos.title: Going On a Date
videos.overview: Murari is in a hurry to get Elaichi married and asks Chote to find a suitable bridegroom. Elaichi asks Pancham to leave the shop and go out on a date with her, but Pancham is too devoted to his job and refuses to come. Elaichi is upset and walks out of the shop infuriated.

videos.title: The First Kiss
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi go out on a movie date. Elaichi feels Pancham is unromantic and expresses her displeasure. Keeping a keen eye on Elaichi and Pancham are two strangers, who are also in the theatre. Later, these two strangers meet Chote to discuss a marriage alliance. Chote, on behalf of Murari, is discussing Elaichi's marriage.

videos.title: Gathering The Courage
videos.overview: Elaichi overhears Murari talking to Chatanki about finding a suitable groom for her, so she gets frustrated and lets it off on Pancham, and asks him to talk to Murari about their marriage. Pancham gathers the courage and writes a letter to Murari confessing his feelings for Elaichi and asking him for Elaichi's hand.

videos.title: Dear Murari Bansal
videos.overview: Pancham writes a letter to Murari and confesses his love for Elaichi but that letter somehow gets into the wrong hands and things go sideways. Chote brings a potential groom for Elaichi but that guy turns out to be the same guy who saw Pancham kissing Elaichi in the movie hall.

videos.title: Winter is Here
videos.overview: Winter has come and Elaichi wishes to go on a morning walk with Pancham holding hands, but things go sideways when Inspector Pinki Ji sees them holding hands in the market through CCTV footage, and then shows the footage to Murari.

videos.title: Inseparable
videos.overview: Murari is worried about Elaichi as her hand is in Pancham's hand. Murari is enraged at Chatanki, who brought the superglue in the first place. Karuna and Murari try to find various solutions to separate Elaichi and Pancham, unaware that Elaichi is lying.

videos.title: Stuck In Love
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham's hands are inseparable due to the superglue, so when Pancham decides to take a bath before leaving for work, he tries to convince Murari to help him. Chatanki takes the super glue to inspector Pinki and somehow Pinki Ji's hands get stuck with a frying pan.

videos.title: Glued Together
videos.overview: Murari finds himself stuck with none other than Chatanki. The superglue that brought together Elaichi and Pancham has now made Chatanki and Murari inseparable. Later, a prospective bridegroom pays a visit to Murari's house to finalize marriage with Elaichi.

videos.title: The Hands are Free
videos.overview: Murari is finally freed from Chatanki and so is Elaichi from Pancham. Later, Elaichi sees Pancham hugging a girl and presumes he is having an affair.

videos.title: Love is War
videos.overview: Elaichi confronts Pancham on him hugging a random girl in the market. Pancham pleads for his innocence but it has no effect on Elaichi. Elaichi decides to keep the argument going even after knowing the truth because love is balanced by arguments.

videos.title: Panchams Sorrow
videos.overview: Pancham is very sad about Elaichi not understanding her innocence. Elsewhere, Sunita's father tries to woo Pintu and Pintu is not happy about it.

videos.title: Elaichi Continues The Torture
videos.overview: After all that Pancham is going through because of Elaichi's elaborate plan of troubling Pancham, she doesn't stop there and goes on a ride with Lalit which is not acceptable by Pancham.

videos.title: The Remedy to Panchams Problems
videos.overview: With the continued troubles with Elaichi, Pancham is sad and confused as he hasn't figured out how to deal with the situation. Murari advises Pancham on how to take control of his life.

videos.title: Pancham Takes Control
videos.overview: After taking Murari's advise, Pancham has decided to hold his fort and confronts Lalit and sends him away. Pancham also confronts Elaichi about the same and Elaichi in return gives Pancham a daunting challenge and also informs him that if he fails to do so, she will propose Lalit.

videos.title: Energy Pill
videos.overview: A neighbour of Karuna visits after a long time and they chit-chat until Karuna's friend tells her about an energy pill which is supposed to rejuvenate Murari. This talk is overheard by Elaichi.

videos.title: The Mix-up
videos.overview: Karuna gives the pill to Murari thinking it will bring out the romantic side in him but,unfortunately, due to a mix-up, the pill gets exchanged with Chatanki's medicine. Meanwhile, Elaichi surprises Pancham by decorating his room.

videos.title: Pinki Jis Struggle
videos.overview: After getting suspended, Pinki Ji, in collaboration with Chote and Murari, has opened up a Chole-Bhature stall. But, they haven't started the business due to Murari's absence. Pinki Ji has invited the commissioner for tasting the handmade Chole -Bhature.

videos.title: Pills Effect On Pancham
videos.overview: After taking the love pill, Pancham's romance has gone to another level where he has got a tattoo done of his and Elaichi's name. Elsewhere, Murari and Chutanki because of the exchange of pill are in deep trouble of their own.

videos.title: Murari's Suspicion
videos.overview: The effect of the pill finally wears off and Pancham goes back to being normal. Meanwhile, Murari is getting suspicious and starting to believe that Pancham is having an affair.

videos.title: The Tree Of Doubt
videos.overview: Pancham buys bangles for Elaichi and Murari sees him buying the bangles and assumes that it is for Pinki Ji's wife. His doubt of Pancham having an extra marital affair is growing stronger day by day and he asks Pancham to meet him at Chote's store.

videos.title: Pinki Ji In Tears
videos.overview: Pancham gets locked and stuck in Murari's father's closet and cannot come out. On the other hand, Pinki Ji is in tears as his wife is missing. Murari informs Pinki about the doubts he had about Pinki Ji's wife and Pancham and infers that both of them have fled together.

videos.title: The Case Of Missing Pancham
videos.overview: Pancham is still locked in the cupboard and Elaichi, despite her many efforts, is unable to help Pancham in getting out of the cupboard. On the other hand, Pinki Ji is looking for Pancham to get some answers regarding why is he having an extra-marital affair with his wife.

videos.title: Rest In Peace
videos.overview: After a long day in the cupboard, Pancham is still stuck there. Elaichi has told her parents that its their great-grandfather whose soul is stuck inside the cupboard. Chote suggests that on the auspicious day of Lohri, they should burn the cupboard and let his soul rest in peace.

videos.title: Saving Jijaji
videos.overview: Pancham fears he will be burned alive and asks Elaichi to save him. When all the family members have gathered to set fire to the wardrobe, Elaichi manages to get Pancham out of the wardrobe. Pintu is relieved to see Pancham alive and well.

videos.title: Shimla
videos.overview: Elaichi's school is planning a trip to Shimla and she wants Pancham to come for the trip as well. Elsewhere, Pinki Ji gives two tickets to Murari for Shimla. Murari commits to Karu and Chote both.

videos.title: Pancham's Leave
videos.overview: Pancham and Pintu want a leave from work to go to Shimla but Murari and Karuna have their own plans to join Elaichi for the Shimla trip. Elaichi wants Pancham to take a leave at any cost and threatens him to break up.

videos.title: Lying For Love
videos.overview: Pancham lies to Murari about the health of Pintus relative in order get leave from work. However, Panchams plan fails and he faces the wrath of Elaichi. Murari informs Pinky that Karuna has found out about his trip and is upset.

videos.title: Shimla - Fun or Trouble?
videos.overview: Everyone is confusd about their trip to Shimla. Murari dupes Chote to go to Shimla with Karuna, but Karuna gets injured. He goes back to Chote to convince him for the trip. Pancham tries to lie about his relative's health condition twice, but they fail both times.

videos.title: Plan's For The Shimla Trip
videos.overview: Pintu asks Sunita to save him from her father. Meanwhile, Pancham is dejected as he is unable to get leave from work and make a trip to Shimla with Elaichi. Murari is having plans of his own and seeks permission from Karuna to go on a trip to Shimla with Chote.

videos.title: The Ghost In Chandni Chowk
videos.overview: There has been a rumour that a ghost is roaming on the streets of Chandni Chowk during the nights who takes away the married woman, one by one. Pancham, on the other hand, is battling against another challenge, which Elaichi has put up, of confessing their love to Murari.

videos.title: Night Guards
videos.overview: The challenge put in front of Pancham by Elaichi to confess his love in front of Murari is not going Pancham's way. Elaichi threatens Pancham for breakup. On the other hand, Pinki Ji has come up with a solution for the ghost issue, i.e. two people will guard the area in the night and the names will come out at random.
