videos.title: Chatanki's Marriage Proposal
videos.overview: A marriage proposal has come for Chatanki and he is very excited to get married to a foreigner named Rajeshwari. The father of the girl has asked for fifty thousand rupees from her to get married to Chatanki. Also, Elaichi has come up with a plan to get rid of Pintu bhabhi so that Pancham can confess his love for Elaichi to Murari.

videos.title: Pintu is Missing
videos.overview: Pancham informs Murari that Pintu is missing and probably has been abducted by the witch. As per the plan, Elaichi asks Murari to get Pancham married as soon as possible. Murari decides to file a missing complaint first and approaches Pinky Ji.

videos.title: The Lottery
videos.overview: Murari and Chote venture out in the night to find the witch who has been haunting the neighborhood. Unaware that Pinky Ji has disguised himself as the witch, Murari and Chote beat him up. Meanwhile, Pintu and Pancham find out that Pintu has won a lottery.

videos.title: Pintu is Back
videos.overview: Pancham reveals to Murari and Pinky Ji that Pintu is alive. Unfortunately for Pancham and Pintu, the lottery they won turns out to be fake. Sunitas father is ecstatic seeing Pintu alive. Later, the news bulletin reveals that the hauntings of the witch was a fraudulent act and was carried out by a gang.

videos.title: Cake Fight
videos.overview: There is a cake wave going around in chandni chowk. Any man who speaks to a woman gets hit by a cake and no one knows from where. Pinki Ji has brought a marriage proposal for Elaichi. Murari agrees to see them as the guy is London return.

videos.title: Elaichi's Marriage Proposoal
videos.overview: Murari recieves a marriage proposal for Elaichi. The family who is interested in Elaichi is of the Superintendent of Police and Murari is excited to meet them as they are a very well off family. Elaichi comes up with a plan to send them back.

videos.title: Elaichi's Engagement
videos.overview: Murari wants Elaichi to get married. Elaichi is all set to create a bad impression in front of the prospective bridegroom. But, Elaichis plan fails and the prospective bridegroom agrees to marry Elaichi. Chote is angry with Murari as Pinky Ji has played a vital role in Elaichis engagement and Murari is giving the entire credit to Pinky Ji.

videos.title: No Way Out
videos.overview: Even though Elaichi and Pancham are trying their level best to break the marriage proposal, all their efforts have gone to vain, as their horoscopes are matched and everything looks good. Noni's parents want to get done with the engagement as soon as possible.

videos.title: The Final Solution
videos.overview: Sonpal suspects that Pintu might be a man. With help from Sunita, Pintu assures Sonpal that his suspicion is wrong. Meanwhile, Elaichi and Pancham are worried as Elaichi's marriage is on the cards. Elaichi decides to convince Noni to reject her and end the marriage talks altogether.

videos.title: Elaichi Breaks The Ice
videos.overview: After Noni says yes for the marriage with Elaichi, Elaichi interrupts everyone and says no for the marriage and tells everyone that Noni loves someone else and explains to Noni's father that you should respect your wards decisions.

videos.title: Murari In Hospital
videos.overview: Murari is admitted in the hospital following an accident. Pancham decides to donate blood to Murari and during the procedure, Pancham and Elaichi start noticing that Pancham is slowly turning into a woman. Pintu is also shocked to find out the drastic change in Pancham.

videos.title: Pancham's Transformation
videos.overview: The doctor accepts the accusation of injecting Pancham with the female hormone and Pancham has already started feeling the effects of the injection. They ask for a remedy from the doctor and he tells them a solution.

videos.title: Pinki Ji- The Saviour
videos.overview: As now, Pancham has fully transformed into a woman, while walking through the market some goons eve-tease Elaichi and Pancham and Pinki Ji comes to their rescue and saves them both. Pancham becomes fond of Pinki Ji.

videos.title: Pancham Loves Pinki Ji
videos.overview: Looking at Murari giving Pancham a hug, Karuna gets shocked and asks Murari to stay away from Pancham as he is no more a man and Pancham overhears the conversation and assures Karuna that there is nothing goin on between him and Murari as he has developed a liking for Pinki Ji.

videos.title: Pancham The Powerful
videos.overview: Elaichi and Sunita are excited about the upcoming Valentines Day and are expecting surprises from Pancham and Pintu. Murari notices that Pancham is very strong and can lift heavy objects easily. Then, Murari learns that in order for Karuna to lose weight, someone has to lift her on Valentines Day.

videos.title: Elaichi Fools Murari
videos.overview: After seeing Pancham's power, Elaichi thinks of a superb plan to stay close to Pancham. Accorrding to the plan Pintu calls Murari as Elaichis lover and threatens to nab her if she doesnt come with him for the valentines. Elaichi suggests that she get Pancham as a bodyguard so that he can keep her safe.

videos.title: Unwell Pancham
videos.overview: Pancham falls near the porch and says that he is unwell and is felling dizzy. Elaichi suggests that he should be taken to her room and they call the doctor.

videos.title: The Special Moment
videos.overview: Pancham is preparing himself for lifting Karuna and gets a helping hand from Elaichi, who has a special surprise for Pancham. Elaichi has brought an injection for Pancham, which will help him easily lift Karuna. Things dont turn out as expected and when Pancham tries to lift Karuna, he breaks his back. Nevertheless, Elaichi and Pancham decide to celebrate Valentines Day.

videos.title: The Trip to Kumbh
videos.overview: After Elaichi sees her friend off from the railway station, she becomes nostalgic about the train trips and wants to go on a train trip with Pancham. Elsewhere, Murari also plans to go and attend the Kumbh by train which gives Elaichi a chance to fulfill her nostalgia.

videos.title: Murari's Permission
videos.overview: As everyone is planning a trip to Kumbh, Pancham wants to join Elaichi on the trip and tries to ask Murari that can he accompany them. Murari agrees to it but Sanju comes in at the same time, and praises Pancham's deed. Listening to that Murari denies Pancham to go to Kumbh.

videos.title: The Trip Begins
videos.overview: Murari, Karuna, and Elaichi are ready to board the train and are waiting for Pancham and Pintu to join them. Pancham is suffering from a bad stomach and they get dealyed in reaching the railway station.

videos.title: Break Fail
videos.overview: Elaichi is enraged at Pancham as he still hasn't boarded the train. As the train leaves from the current stop, Pancham surprises Elaichi by boarding the train. Meanwhile, Pinky Ji pays a visit to Chote's barbershop and Chote reveals that he is dearly missing Murari. Meanwhile, on the train, Pancham and Elaichi find out to their dismay that the breaks have failed on the train.

videos.title: The Last Ride
videos.overview: The breaks of the train have failed and the passengers are in a state of panic. The passengers are certain that the train will meet with an accident and decide to express their final thoughts to their loved ones. Chote gets a call from Murari, who informs him of the unfortunate incident. Pinky Ji decides to be the hero and stop the train at any cost.

videos.title: The Solution
videos.overview: Murari suggests that to stop the train, someone should go and detach the engine from the compartment. No one is ready to go to the engine of the train through the roof. Elaichi suggests that they should make a draw and whosoever's name comes out will have to go and do the task.

videos.title: The Surprise Guest
videos.overview: Elaichi overhears Pancham requesting Pintu to keep a secret. Elaichi is curious to find out about Pancham's secret. Meanwhile, a girl and her father pay a visit to Murari's house and claim that they know Pancham. Pancham is surprised when the girl's father claims that Pancham's marriage has been fixed with the girl a long time ago.

videos.title: Pancham is Married?
videos.overview: Murari calls on Pancham asking him that he didn't inform his relatives are coming. Pancham doesn't recognize those people. They tell him that the girl he came with is the girl he got married to when he was a kid. The girl's father leaves but tells Pancham that he will be back for her daughter's right.

videos.title: Pancham's Struggle
videos.overview: The girl and her father bring Pinki Ji to Murari's shop where they want justice to be done and in doing so Pancham again denies knowing them. Pinki Ji asks Pancham to call the grandmother and get the issue cleared. And when they do so, Pancham's grandmother acknowledges his marriage with the girl. Pancham is in a fix.

videos.title: Pancham's Fate
videos.overview: Elaichi doesnt want Pancham to spend any more time with Futri and decides to intervene. While she manages to save Pancham, Futri is not ready to leave Pancham alone. When Elaichi and Pancham are discussing about Futri in the bathroom, Futri barges inside and see Elaichi and Pancham together.

videos.title: Futri's Future
videos.overview: After Futri catches Pancham and Elaichi in the washroom together, she is shocked to see Pancham being married to two women and having an affair with the third. Pancham requests Futri to go upstairs where he will explain her the situation. Futri's father agrees to go away from there once Pancham is ready to pay him five lac rupees.

videos.title: Fraudsters Caught
videos.overview: Elaichi helps in nabbing the two fraudsters Futri and her father. Futri tries to tell Murari that Elaichi and Pancham are dating. Murari doesnt pay any heed to what she says. Pinki Ji wants Elaichi to explain how did she nab the real fraudsters.

videos.title: Panchams Cold
videos.overview: Pancham has caught cold and while staying the shop he is sneezing a lot and has already scared off a customer. Elaichi enters the shop and Pancham tells her that he doesnt deserve to be in a relationship with her and they should break it off.

videos.title: The Ape
videos.overview: Murari is beginning to feel that Pancham's behaviour is odd. Pancham is acting erratic and his behavior is ape-like. Murari visits Chote's barbershop and Chote reminds him that he hasn't paid him. The same night, Pancham visits Murari and scares him.

videos.title: Panchams Act
videos.overview: Pancham is acting ape-like in order to force Murari to give him a salary hike. Murari is getting petrified seeing Panchams behavior. Chatanki asks Murari to evict Pancham out of the house but thankfully Elaichi manages to convince Murari to give a deserving raise to Pancham.

videos.title: The Monkey Act
videos.overview: Pancham enacts being a monkey just to avoid his tension with Seth Ji. While Elaich wants to take Panchan out for a movie, a guy from nowhere comes to claim money for a car accident.

videos.title: Rebirth
videos.overview: Elaichi learns that Murari believes in rebirth. Elaichi decides to make Murari believe that she and Pancham were lovers in their past life and have taken rebirth to fulfill their destiny. Pancham and Elaichi come up with a plan and decide to execute it that night.

videos.title: Back to The Past
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham pretend in front of Murari that they are having flashbacks of their past lives. Murari is tensed and decides to find a solution to cure Elaichis problem. Pintu suggests that she knows a doctor who is an expert in reincarnation. The next day, Pintu arrives disguised as the doctor.

videos.title: Memories Of The Past
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi put up an act while Pintu acts as the doctor, who specializes in reincarnation cases. Murari and Karuna fall for the act and believe that Elaichi and Pancham were lovers in the past. Pintu uses the trick on Sonpal and tries to make him believe that he and Pintu were brother and sister in their past life.

videos.title: Pancham's Plan
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham take things to the next level to make Murari and Karuna believe that they are indeed reincarnated. Pancham reveals his plan to bring an end to Pintu's life and Murari overhears this plan. Meanwhile, Pintu pays a visit to Pinky Ji disguised as the doctor and informs him that in his past life he came in the way of Pancham and Elaichi's love story.

videos.title: Murari's Decision
videos.overview: Murari is furious and calls all the members to tell them about the big decision taken by him. He tells everyone that he has decided that Murari shall leave the house by tomorrow itself. He says that neither will he stay here, nor will he get any flashbacks about the past.

videos.title: Holi Gift
videos.overview: Elaichi and Sunita sneak into Pancham's room and wish him on the occasion of Holi. Pancham decides to gift Elaichi a present for Holi. Then, Pancham informs Murari that his grandmother has passed away.  Elaichi is enraged at Pancham and decides to find out what he is planning.

videos.title: Back From The Grave
videos.overview: Elaichi is angry with Pancham as the Holi plan is not materializing. Elaichi comes up with a plan and decides to bring Pancham's grandmother from afterlife. Elaichi requests Lalith to disguise himself as Pancham's grandmother and arrive at her house to meet Murari.

videos.title: The Holi Plan
videos.overview: After proclaiming that Pancham's grandmother is alive, Elaichi once again sends her back to the grave and informs Murari that Pancham's grandmother died in an accident. Murari also learns bad news that one of his relatives passed away. Elaichi is upset as her Holi plan is not materialising.

videos.title: Naniji is Still Alive
videos.overview: Elaichi is upset about Naniji, when suddenly she shows up at the house. She explains Murari and all the people of the family how she saved herself from the accident again and everyone buys it and are happy again.

videos.title: The End Of Naniji
videos.overview: Murari finds out that Naniji is Lalith. Elaichi manages to defend herself and Murari not only forgives her but also gives permission to play Holi. Then, Elaichi and Pancham are caught romancing by Murari and he informs this to Karuna. Murari and Karuna are shocked and feel betrayed by Pancham.

videos.title: Elaichi and Pancham Caught
videos.overview: Murari and Karuna are really tensed after seeing Elaichi and Pancham together. Chutanki Mama comes up with a plan of terrifying Pancham and forcing him to leave the house next day. Elaichi hears their conversation and runs to Pancham and tells him everything.

videos.title: Pancham Leaves Without Pintu
videos.overview: Murari is still afraid of Pancham after hearing all the stories about him and decides to fire him from the shop and send him from the house. Hearing this, elaichi comes up with another plan and sends Pancham without Pappu.

videos.title: Ghosts Everywhere!
videos.overview: Jijaji wants the vampire out of the house. The police wants the witch out of the station. There are ghosts everywhere! Everyone in the town are scared. Jija is living his life in fear.

videos.title: Murari The Doctor!
videos.overview: Murari hatches a plan where he enters Pancham's room and offers him icecream laced with sedatives. Once Pancham eats the icecream, he falls unconscious and Murari ties him up so that he can poke a hole into his heart to take the dracula soul out of his body.

videos.title: Finding a Guy For Elaichi
videos.overview: Elaichi tells Pancham that Murari is finding a rich guy for her to get married to. Murari is upset with his wife as her brother ate all the kheer and he leaves his food half eaten on his plate.

videos.title: Enters Nag Khurana
videos.overview: A big businessman enters Murari's shop and tells him his story of his lost son. Murari takes him inside, where Pancham sees him and asks him to leave. On being asked, Murari finds out that Pancham is his son and he has left everything and decided to live alone.

videos.title: Khurana's Idea
videos.overview: As planned, Pancham's plan is going according to their expectations, and now is the time where Nag Khurana goes to Murari and speaks to him about Pancham and Elaichi's marriage.

videos.title: It is Almost Fixed
videos.overview: Elaichi comes running to Jijaji while he is sitting on the terrace. Jijaji is happy to see Elaichi excited and asks her the reason. She informs him that her father agreed.

videos.title: Murari Asked For The Murari Asked For The Dowry
videos.overview: Elaichi's father asked for the 1 crore rupees from Panchams father and after getting one crore then only Elaichi will get married to Pancham.

videos.title: Pancham Steals The Gold
videos.overview: Elaichi keeps her father occupied by pretending to be insomniac. He tries to put her to sleep while Pancham sets to steal from the room. He succeeds in stealing the gold and rushing to his room, while Elaichi keeps her father distracted.

videos.title: Lost Jewellery
videos.overview: Elaichi's parents are shocked when they find Pinky's jewellery missing from the locker. Elaichi insists that Pancham helps them find the lost jewellery. Murari tries stopping Pinky from coming to his house.

videos.title: Elaichi Accepts Her Mistake
videos.overview: Pancham prays to God asking him to help him find his bag consisting of jewellery. To flatter Pinky, Murari and his wife offer him sweets. Elaichi finally reveals that she had taken the jewellery which has now been stolen by some monkey.

videos.title: Murari Returns Pinky's Valuables
videos.overview: Pancham dresses up as a monkey and Elaichi plays a Madari to get the jewellery back. Elaichi trades bananas for the jewellery and tricks the real monkey into returning it. Murari then returns Pinky's valuables back to him.

videos.title: Murari and His Revenge
videos.overview: Pancham tells Murari and Elaichi that his maternal side of the family were all dacoits and his grandfather, named Mangal Singh, was the biggest dacoit of them all. Murari gets furious and leaves as his needs to avenge his grandfather who was killed by Mangal Singh.

videos.title: Murari Disrespects Pancham
videos.overview: Elaichi takes a stand when Murari orders Pancham to polish Chatanki's shoes. Pancham feels disrespected when he has to clean the shoes. Elaichi tries to come up with ideas to make Murari stop insulting Pancham.

videos.title: Pintoo Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Pintoo plays Panchams uncle who is a dacoit brags about the crime that he has committed and gets arrested. Sunita asks Elaichi and Pancham to get Pintoo back as soon as possible. Pinky tortures Pintoo in the jail in a unique way.

videos.title: The Big Revelation
videos.overview: Murari drops the photo frame of his Nanaji and finds a letter in it. When he reads the letter he gets to know that there's no Daaku Mangalsingh and it was just a cover-up story which was spread by his Nanaji himself because he was irritated by his wife and he wanted to just run away from everyone.

videos.title: Elaichi Plans For Marriage
videos.overview: Elaichi tries convincing her parents about her dreams of being a doctor and denies early marriage as well. When she meets Pancham, she plans to marry him with her parents consent.

videos.title: Elaichi's Father Gets Overwhelmed
videos.overview: Elaichi's father gets very happy upon getting a huge order from a customer. He thanks Elaichi for her prediction. Later at night, Elaichi dreams of pancham kissing her father and informs pancham the same next morning.

videos.title: Elaichi Dreams Of The Future
videos.overview: Elaichi again dreams of her mother slapping her father. She restlessly goes to her father to caution him about her dream. Even after the caution, her father gets slapped by her mother and explains as she was hitting a Dengue mosquito.

videos.title: Elaichi Plans For Marriage With Pancham
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi plan to marry each other through Elaichi's dream. And on the other side, Elaichi's mother is very tensed of her dreams, as everything was cog true.

videos.title: Elaichis Horrific Dream
videos.overview: Elaichi again dreams of her father killing Pancham and she informs Pancham about this as well. Later when her father calls Pancham to give him mangoes to eat, he starts running ferociously to save his life.

videos.title: Elaichi Acts Childish
videos.overview: When Elaichi and Pancham are busy on the roof, suddenly her father sees them and gets angry. To escape the situation, Elaichi starts acting like a child to fool the family members.

videos.title: Another Proposal For Elaichi
videos.overview: Elaichi is furious when Murari informs her that the commissioner's son is going to meet her for marriage. She goes to Pancham and pushes him to ask her hand in marriage from Murari. Pancham is hesitant and finds excuses.

videos.title: Marriage Proposal For Elaichi
videos.overview: Elaichi's father comes home very happy after getting back the rejected marriage proposal for Elaichi. But Elaichi gets confused about how to react and leaves for beauty parlor

videos.title: Elaichi Fools Her Parents
videos.overview: Elaichi again gets caught while being with Pancham and fools her parents by being childish and makes them believe that she is not out of her mental disorder. And her father as well fixes her marriage with another man.

videos.title: Elaichi Romantic Dream
videos.overview: Elaichi again dreams but this time a romantic dream. She dreams of her honeymoon with Pancham and in between she wakes up and gets surprised of the dreams. And again escapes from her father for being caught with Pancham.

videos.title: An Alien Visit
videos.overview: Murari wakes up in a bad mood. At work, he decides to cut 10 percent from Panchams wage after deciding that his employee has become too rich. Elaichi comes up with an idea of how to change her dads mind with the help of the local news and an alien custom.

videos.title: Murari is Scared
videos.overview: After seeing an alien in his washroom while taking bath, Murari is in shock and is scared to death. He is shivering all over and inspite of people telling him that there is nothing as such in the washroom, he doesn't want to believe.

videos.title: Making The Next Move
videos.overview: Elachi and Jijaji decide to tell her father about getting married to each other and asks Lalu to convince Murari on this matter. Murari is still paranoid  of another alien visit and Pinky is put on high alert to protect him.

videos.title: The Fake Marriage
videos.overview: Elaichi and Jijaji are ready to get married but Elaichi's mother is getting emotional because her daughter will get married and go away. Elaichi reminds her that she will be going upstairs only after get getting married. Pinky comes and tells Murari that there's no alien, someone made a fool out of them. Murari then reveals that this was a fake marriage as well and once the aliens would have gone back he was going to tell this to everyone.

videos.title: Missing Pearl
videos.overview: Elaichi requests Jijaji to pick her some mangoes from the tree since he never does anything romantic for her. A friend of Khurana comes to visit, asking for the return of her necklace. Khurana is shocked to find out there is a pearl missing from the necklace.

videos.title: A Box Of Mangoes
videos.overview: The family is still busy searching for the lost pearl when Jijaji arrives at the shop with a crate full of mangoes. Elachi tries to put Jijaji in a good light in front of her father's eyes with this action.

videos.title: The Diamonds are Located
videos.overview: The diamonds from the mango are suspected to be inside Murari's stomach but that fact is not known to him. This is confirmed to Elaichi and Jijaji when the doctor gives his report on Murari's condition. The doctor gives him medicine which will give him pressure to release whatever is shining inside of him.

videos.title: Elaichi's Nightmare
videos.overview: Murari finds out about Jijaji and Elaichi and forbids their marriage. Elaichi wakes up from her sleep and realizes it was all a dream. However, she worries that these recurring dreams are a bad sign and she decides something has to be done.

videos.title: Lucky Turn Of Events
videos.overview: Pintu while busy working out with dumbbells, throws out his wig because it was irritating him. Murari discovers the wig and is furious. However, when climbing down the stairs, he slips and falls and goes into a coma. The doctor reveals that Murari has lost part of his memories.

videos.title: Aftereffects Of The Accident
videos.overview: Muraris accident is having a different effect on everyone. There is now a lot hanging on the line depending on whether his memories return or not.  Pancham and Pintu are worried once the memories return, they will be thrown out or worse. Elaichi is worried for his well being and so is her mother.

videos.title: Murari's Condition
videos.overview: Elaichi, Pancham, Pintu, and Sunita are once again sitting around feeling worried over the well-being of Murari. The doctor reveals that his memory has gone once again. Murari has once again reverted back to his former condition.

videos.title: Connection Loose
videos.overview: After Murari regains his memory he wants to confront Pancham and tries to go upstairs but instead Karuna tries to go upstairs and ends up falling on Murari who loses his memory again.

videos.title: Remembering What Happened
videos.overview: Murari's recovery is underway. A hypnotist tries to help him regain his memories. Pancham and Pintu get nervous when Murari is told to remember events from the past few days.

videos.title: Getting Tattoos
videos.overview: Karuna gets a visit from her best friend and they catch up. Murari overhears their conversation and plans to surprise his wife by getting a tattoo. At the shop, Murari forces Pancham to dress in ladies costume and dance around.

videos.title: Case Of Mistaken Towel
videos.overview: Elachi comes with so much excitement to meet Pancham to see his tattoo and their romance is blooming once again. Pancham and Murari get into a tug of war over a towel in the morning.

videos.title: The Strange News
videos.overview: Everyone is sitting around listening to the news-There is a crazy person going around slapping men three times if they are wearing clothes instead of a towel. Both Pintu and  Pacham are put in an awkward situation because of this.

videos.title: Skipping Dinner
videos.overview: The family is having dinner with the couple from upstairs with Pancham and Murari sitting there with arms folded to hide their tattoos. They each try to come up with excuses over this strange behavior.

videos.title: The Mad Man
videos.overview: Karuna is mad at Murari as the tattoo he had got done on his chest has gone horribly wrong and she suspects him of having an affair.On the other hand, Pinki, Mangi Lal and the commissioner have locked themselves in the jail till the mad man is caught.

videos.title: Elaichi's Father is Injured
videos.overview: Elaichi along with her mother and uncle are playing some game in the verandah of their house and Elaichi's father gets injured. And Elaichi asks Pancham to receive her grandmother from the bus stop.

videos.title: An Urgent Work
videos.overview: Elaichi and her family are having some nice time to themselves when Pintu and Sunita come calling for her. They are adamant that she leaves with them.

videos.title: Pancham Found Daddi
videos.overview: Pancham finally finds grandma, in a street corner, drinking lime water. He tells the gang back home the good news. Sunita can now finally take off her disguise.

videos.title: Naughty Granny
videos.overview: Grandma is once again on the loose and Pancham finds her. He tries hard to convince her to come home. When suddenly there is a power outage, granny once again disappears.

videos.title: Love Letter For Murari
videos.overview: Ilaichi and Sunita discuss about their friend Niddhi and her cheating boyfriend. Murari's barber tells him about his love life. Pancham and Ilaichi share a romantic moment. Lattu receives a love letter but he asks Murari to keep it with himself. Pancham reads Lattu's love letter and thinks it was for Murari.

videos.title: The Letter
videos.overview: Pancham gets a bad dream in which he sees both Elaichi and her mother are trying to commit suicide after getting a letter from Elaichi's father. But suddenly he wakes up and sees Elaichi in front of him and thinks of revealing the truth.

videos.title: Murari Exposes Dixit
videos.overview: Pancham calls Gulabiya to meet him and tries to explain to her that whatever she is doing is wrong. Murari tells everyone that Dixit is having an affair with someone. Elaichi thinks that Pancham is having an affair with Gulabiya.

videos.title: Elaichi Gets Jealous
videos.overview: Murari asks Pancham to take Gulabiya's clothing measurements, Elaichi looks at Pancham taking the measurement and gets jealous. Mangilal asks Pinky to dance for him. Pancham deals with a nightmare.

videos.title: Elaichis Dreams
videos.overview: While sleeping, Elaichi dreams about Jijaji having another relation with Gulabiya and wakes up in haste because of the dream. Sunita helps her in understanding that it was just a dream.

videos.title: Panchams Twin Brother
videos.overview: Murari is looking for someone who would like to marry Elaichi. Elaichi, on the other hand, makes a plan that she can't marry Pancham but she can always marry his twin brother. Pinki gets beaten up by people. Murari invites his Guruji to talk about Elaichi.

videos.title: Pancham In Trouble
videos.overview: Chhotanki sees Pancham and Elaichi watching a movie together and informs her parents. Elaichi somehow surpasses the accusations but Pancham gets into trouble as Elaichi's father decides to fire him out of the job.

videos.title: Pancham Argues With Elaichi
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi argue for the problem ahead of them, which involves betraying Murari, and Pancham denies doing so. Elaichi says that she has a plan and they shall work on it.

videos.title: Pushpendras Meeting With Murari
videos.overview: Elaichi offers to resolve the issue between Pancham and Pushpendra. Pushpendra comes to meet Murari and family for lunch. Pushpendra gifts dry fruits to Murari but Murari asks him too many questions about it. Pushpendra tells everyone that he invested lots of money for Pancham but he wasted everything.

videos.title: Aladdin In Elaichis Dreams
videos.overview: Today's episode starts with Elaichi running behind Pancham with a stick to hit him, as he ruined her plan. Later, Aladdin arrives in Elaichi's dreams and warns her to handle the situation carefully in front of her parents.

videos.title: Elaichis Plan Backfires
videos.overview: Pancham becomes an NRI to convince Mr. Bansal for Elaichi's marriage with him. The plan backfires and Pancham becomes the victim of both, the police and Mr. Bansal's outrage.

videos.title: Elaichi's Marriage Proposal
videos.overview: Mr. Bansal fetches the prospective groom for her daughter, fulfilling every merit. Elaichi tries hard to reject the proposal.

videos.title: Elaichi Agrees to Marry
videos.overview: Elaichi accepts the marriage proposal with her suitor. Pancham is heart-broken. In the meantime, Elaichi's granny arrives with a ray of hope.

videos.title: Granny to The Rescue
videos.overview: Elaichi's granny understands Pancham's relation with her granddaughter and tries to convince her son, Murari, for the same. However, their plan fails and they are again back to ground zero.

videos.title: Elaichi is Desperate
videos.overview: Elaichi insists Pancham to confess their love to Murari. When Pancham fails to do so, Elaichi tries but Murari still ignores. Now, Elaichi's granny has a plan for them.

videos.title: Pancham Marries Elaichi
videos.overview: Elaichi's granny tricks Pancham and Elaichi to believe that she is suffering from an incurable disease. She wishes to see them getting married. Hence, Pancham and Elaichi begin with the marriage proceedings.

videos.title: Happily Married
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham successfully complete the wedding rituals. However, Elaichi is worried about how her father will react to the situation.

videos.title: Elaichi's Dad is Here
videos.overview: Murari arrives home after the wedding and doesn't seem in a mood to consent to the situation. Elaichi's granny tries to explain him.

videos.title: Ideological Clash
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi are trying to justify a love marriage while Murari thinks that arranged marriage is a better option.

videos.title: The Honeymoon
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi arrange their honeymoon night with the help of granny. Everything goes smoothly until Murari knocks at their door.

videos.title: Murari Interrupts
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi are yet to celebrate their honeymoon. Meanwhile, Murari continuously interrupts them for various reasons.

videos.title: Murari Doubts
videos.overview: Murari suspects some mischief in Pancham's room and appears again as a disturbance to the couple. Pancham and Elaichi are in trouble.

videos.title: Thief In The House
videos.overview: While Pancham and Elaichi are yet to celebrate their honeymoon, a thief breaks into their room. Inspector Pinky, who is behind the thief, lands in their room at night.

videos.title: Blooming Romance
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham are now meeting under hideous circumstances, avoiding Murari and others. Meanwhile, Sunnu's father tries to woo Pintu.

videos.title: Love Birds
videos.overview: Inspector Pinky sees Pancham and Elaichi romancing in the street and suspiciously interrogates them. But Elaichi manages to explain the inspector and divert him smartly.

videos.title: Chhotankis Drama
videos.overview: Chhotanki doesn't complete his food, gets questioned by Elaichi's father and he replies that he is suffering from stomach ache. Elaichi along with her father insults Chhotanki which hurts him.

videos.title: Comedy Of Romances
videos.overview: Pinky again sees Pancham and Elaichi romancing in the rain and again the couple had to divert the situation. On the other hand, Pintu is stalked by Chhotanki and Sunnu's father.

videos.title: Pancham and Elaichi Hire a Priest
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi hire a priest to get their marriage certificate and the formalities done. They want Pintu's name with Pancham to avoid problems. The priest doesn't agree.

videos.title: Narrow Escape
videos.overview: Mr. and Mrs. Bansal are on a mission to catch a rat in the house. In the process, they check Elaichi's almirah where the marriage certificate is kept. But Pancham arrives at the moment and saves himself and Elaichi.

videos.title: Grandfather's Trunk
videos.overview: Bansal family tries to open the trunk of Elaichi's grandfather in which the marriage certificate is kept. Elaichi tries to obstruct them but fails. Murari opens the trunk to find nothing but waste.

videos.title: The Marriage Certificate
videos.overview: Elaichi arrives at the shop where Pancham is sitting. She plays a prank with Pancham and thereafter tells him to hide the marriage certificate in a secret place in the shop.

videos.title: The Inspector Trouble
videos.overview: An inspector comes and knocks on Pancham and Elaichi's hotel door. He asks them what are they doing in the hotel. Pancham tells him that they are a married couple and they were going to a temple, but they had to take up a room in this hotel because they were tired. Police inspector asks them for a marriage certificate but they dont have one.

videos.title: Pancham In Trouble
videos.overview: Inspector arrives at Murari's shop and tells Murari that he had seen Pancham with an unknown girl in a hotel last night. He demands the marriage certificate to be shown.

videos.title: Elaichi Needs Phone
videos.overview: Elaichi gets worried as she is not having her wedding photos and asks Pancham to get them but he suggests another idea to have a photoshoot session in marriage attire. Later Elaichi asks her father for a phone but gets refused

videos.title: Gift For Elaichi
videos.overview: Murari gifts Elaichi a new phone but takes away her old phone without even informing her. Pancham calls Elaichi and says something that Murari shouldn't have listened to but he did.

videos.title: Murari is Confused
videos.overview: Pancham hides his face and sweeps where Murari and other locals are sitting. He overhears their gossip and later tells Murari not to hang around with them.

videos.title: The Mobile Thief
videos.overview: Pinky brings a mobile thief to Murari's shop for identification. Pancham and Elaichi plan to give Murari his specs so that he can identify the thief. But the plan backfires.

videos.title: Elaichi's Plan
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham plan to get her father a new phone instead of an old phone, so they plan to steal his old phone first and later can get him a new one. But her father catches them both while stealing his phone and the truth comes out.

videos.title: Karuna is Furious
videos.overview: Karuna has fought with her husband Murari and decides not to talk to him. Meanwhile, Lattu uncle is about to become a father. Murari gets tensed sitting in Lattu's parlour where he gets an idea to solve his conflict with his wife.

videos.title: The Gift Drama
videos.overview: Elaichi asks Sunnu if Pancham will like her gift or not. While Elaichi is on her way to give the gift to Pancham, her mother thinks someone gifted something to Elaichi. Elaichi lies to her mother and tells her that her Science teacher gifted her something because she solved a problem in her class.

videos.title: The Gifts Get Interchanged
videos.overview: Elaichi and her father get gifts for their spouses for this special occasion. There is a mistake that happens and the gifts are interchanged. Elaichi's mother gets Pancham's gift and vice versa. Now they are awkward with the gifts and on the other hand, Elaichi and her father persuade them to wear the gifts on the occasion.

videos.title: Jijaji In a Nighty
videos.overview: Pancham wears the interchanged gift that Elaichi brought for him. He can't meet Elaichi at first because her father is in the front yard. Her mother, however, doesn't wear the gift as she is too shy.

videos.title: Jijaji can do Anything For Elaichi
videos.overview: Jijaji is teased on the road, yet he wears the nighty and comes to meet Elaichi in the cafe. Elaichi realizes that the gifts have been misplaced. She is happy how Jijaji would do anything for her.

videos.title: Couple Fight At Elaichi's House
videos.overview: Elaichi's mother and father argue with each other. Jijaji comes to take a stand for Elaichi but instead gets a beating from her mother. Sethji is also in a rough mood and Pinkyji is being a nuisance.

videos.title: Jijaji Gets Another Beating
videos.overview: The argument between Elaichi's mother and father take an unusual turn. Her mother wants to leave the house and as usual, Jijaji comes in good faith to help sort things out. However, today he gets a beating from Sethji. Things are upset at the house.

videos.title: Elaichi is Playing Rebel
videos.overview: Elaichi's father asks her to sit near him and have a talk. He pretends to be on a call with one of his friends and discusses the bizarre and adverse effects of gambling. Elaichi keeps on listening and as asked she promises him not to gamble again.

videos.title: Pancham's Heartmelting Confession
videos.overview: Murari confronts Pancham about the alcohol addiction Elaichi is suffering through. Pancham comes clean about it and he says that she started drinking because of her parent's marital issues. After listening to this, Murari's heart melts and he appreciates Pancham's effort for keeping Elaichi in her limits.

videos.title: Elaichi's Plan Works Out Well
videos.overview: Murari is pleased to see that Pancham is taking good care of the Bansal family's reputation. A while later, Murari receives a letter by Elaichi, which says, she has left home. Panicked to hear that, Murari runs to his house and gathers Karuna to share the news.

videos.title: Its All About The Goat
videos.overview: Elaichi is having issues with Param and she shares this with her best friend. Meanwhile, Pinky Ji is making Gajar Ka Halwa in the Police Station. Commissioner asks him to keep an eye on his Billi. But Billi is biologically a Goat and is named as such. Things get even more hilarious after this.

videos.title: Billi Comes Between Jijaji and Elaichi
videos.overview: Pinky Ji is busy making Laddoo for Billi. Meanwhile, Billi is at Jijajis place and Pinky Ji has no clue about it. After getting the news from Mangi Lal Pinky Ji somehow manages to convince the commissioner. Meanwhile, Jijaji is busy impressing Elaichi with his nurturing skills.

videos.title: The Goat Story
videos.overview: Pinky Ji comes to Jijaji's house and accuses him of stealing the goat. He doesn't get moved by Elaichi. This turns into a big confusion. Jijaji is trying to save himself from the mess but Pinky Ji is quite convinced.

videos.title: Blessed Goat
videos.overview: Jijaji tells the truth about the goat to Elaichi. They try to fix things on their own but when they come home, they see that the goat has been blessed by the pandit and Murari wants to buy the goat. Jijaji sells the goat for fifteen thousand rupees. Pinki Ji is still figuring out what happened to his goat.

videos.title: Pancham is Scared Of Seth Ji
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi are eating corn together in a nearby shop. While Elaichi is insisting Pancham to hold her hand, Pancham is scared of Murari. Meanwhile, seeing the couple standing so close, a group of men approach them thinking Pancham is trying to hit on some random girl. Things get even more hilarious now.

videos.title: Pancham and Elaichi's Secret
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi get into a discussion of escaping Pinky Uncle's trap, where Pancham gets nervous after thinking about the consequences. Later, the other committers involved in the plan also come to them and together they start planning to escape the situation.

videos.title: Pinki Ji In Trouble
videos.overview: Pinki gets the guy who thrashes Pancham to testify against Elaichi and Pancham in front of Murari. And the guy refuses to recognise Elaichi and Pancham. Murari and Pinki exchange looks.

videos.title: Pinkyji Brings Proof
videos.overview: Pinkyji comes and tells Murari and his wife that Elaichi and Pancham are a married couple. He also tells them that Elaichi was flying like an angel. Murari and his wife deny to believe it and ask him to bring proof. Pinkyji gets CCTV footage and plans to prove his point.

videos.title: Pinkyji Meets Catwoman
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham are working on hiding their secret from Murari and his wife. They are trying to show that Pinkyji is mentally ill. Today Elaichi disguises as Catwoman and comes to the police station. Mangi Lal hears about it from Pinkyji and takes him to the mental rehabilitation center.

videos.title: Pancham's Dream Come True
videos.overview: Pancham dreams about Elaichi's wedding with some random person and at that wedding, Pancham is a waiter. Elaichi has a good laugh about this dream. Meanwhile, Murari's childhood friend came back to town but has a dark truth attached to him.

videos.title: Murari Forgets His Childhood Promise
videos.overview: Murari's childhood friend comes from Dubai to greet him with a shocking surprise. Murari finds out that he is a don in Dubai and has come here expecting Murari to live up to his promise. Elaichi along with her family and Pancham are having a tough time digesting this news.

videos.title: Pancham and Elaichi Accept The Truth
videos.overview: Tarun gladly accepts Elaichi and Pancham's marriage and blesses them. Murari is happy to see that Tarun got deceived by Elaichi. Meanwhile, Pinky Ji is still planning a way to arrest the don, he has an eye on Elaichi's mother. Stay tuned as things get even more hilarious.

videos.title: Don Falls For Pintu
videos.overview: Pinkyji is in search of the Don. On the other hand, Don comes to Murari's house and falls for Pintu. Now he wants to marry Pintu and Murari is trying to convince Pintu to marry the Don. Things are getting more and more difficult for Elaichi, Pancham and their gang.

videos.title: Saving Pintu From Don
videos.overview: Don is getting more and more excited about his marriage with Pintu. Pintu is also really tensed about the entire situation. Pintu comes and requests the others to save him from Don. Elaichi assures him that a plan is in place.

videos.title: Don is Heartbroken
videos.overview: Pintu reveals to Chopra, the Don, that he is a guy. Chopra is extremely shocked by this. He refuses to take Pintu to Dubai. Meanwhile, Murari, Pancham and Elaichi face him and clarify him further.

videos.title: Elaichi has The Solution
videos.overview: Maurari's brother-in-law is at their place and he is a person with a lot of tantrums. They discuss things in their home and he has fun with Murari. Later Elaichi comes and tells Pintu that he will need his identification certificates as Pinkyji is checking the certificates of all the people working at Murari's shop. However, Elaichi brings the solution along with the problem.

videos.title: Inspector Pinky Gets a Task
videos.overview: Inspector Pinky is busy with his culinary items when the commissioner arrives. He is assigned the task to take Babli, a feared thief into custody. The commissioner tells him to abandon the culinary items and be serious about the case.

videos.title: Theft Of The Earrings
videos.overview: Elaichi's uncle wants to stay in the terrace room where Pancham and Pintu stay. He wants them out so he steals his sister's earrings and keeps it in Pintu's room. Elaichi catches them and so does Murari.

videos.title: Another Attempt to Disgrace Pintu
videos.overview: Elaichis uncle tries another time to get Pintu blamed for stealing. This time he tries with Muraris wallet but Elaichi saves them once again. On the other hand, Pinkyji gets Pintus fingerprints.

videos.title: Pintu Remains The Victim
videos.overview: Pancham tries to make things fine with Elaichi, but Elaichi doesn't trust Pintu anymore. On the other hand, Elaichi's uncle continues his attempts to get Pintu and Pancham thrown out of the house. This time things get a bit too serious. He keeps a bag full of money in Pintu's cupboard and he gets caught.

videos.title: Catching Mamaji Together
videos.overview: Mamaji gets caught by Elaichi. She shows everyone the video of Mamaji stealing the money. He gets caught and Pintu is saved from harassment. Pancham also finds a wallet with four thousand rupees and fight with Pintu in regards to sharing the money.

videos.title: Treasure In Murari's House
videos.overview: Pinky Ji's uncle comes to meet him and tells him that there is a treasure in Chandni Chowk. He is an archaeologist and tells that there is a treasure in a house, which happens to be Murari's house. Elaichi eavesdrop over the entire conversation and plans to get the treasure.

videos.title: Mission Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Pintu, Elaichi, and Pancham are all working on finding the treasure at Murari's house. They have made a plan and are working fast. Pinkyji has dressed up as a plumber named Chinki and came to find the treasure as well.

videos.title: Future Plans
videos.overview: Pinky Ji gets caught by everyone and comes clean. On the other hand, Murari and his wife sleep on Elaichi's bed. Elaichi and Pancham are busy making plans for their future with the treasure money they will get. Pintu is tired of digging and wants a break.

videos.title: Pinky Ji Gets a Beating
videos.overview: Jijaji is in Murari's bedroom and keeps them out yet again. Pinkyji disguises as a gas company personnel. He is almost going to break the door open but Mangi Lal misinforms Murari that Pinkyji is a thief. He gets a beating by all of them.

videos.title: Murari Learns About The Treasure
videos.overview: Murari tries a new trick to get everyone out of his bedroom and it works. He then finds the hole dug in the ground. At that time, Pinky Ji comes and tells the truth about the treasure that is buried there. They all start digging together to find the treasure.

videos.title: Finding Treasure
videos.overview: All the men along with Pancham, Chhotanki and Elaichi's father go in search of treasure, but during the search, a snake arrives in the scene and everybody gets scared. Later, they continue to search and at last, they just get a book which makes them disappointed.

videos.title: Pancham is Going to Space
videos.overview: Pancham gets the approval that he will be going to space. He gets a lot of popularity and everyone is happy about it. Murari is also very glad about the situation. Pintu complains about their relationship with Elaichi's mother.

videos.title: Pintu Cries
videos.overview: Murari is impressed that Pancham has been to space and admires him. Chatanki reminds Murari that he will be alone in his shop now. Pintu is seen crying outside the house recalling Pancham. Then Pancham arrives at the house.

videos.title: Pancham's Space Fraud
videos.overview: Pancham is ready to pretend that he is leaving for space. This is a trick to get married with Elaichi and tell her parents. Pancham goes and then hides and returns to his room. Pinkyji, however, sees him on the road and comes to Murari.

videos.title: Pintu's Lovers
videos.overview: Pancham has a stomach problem and he is going through a lot of pain. There are several people who want to marry Pintu and they come to Murari for help. Murari also gets the news that the spaceship that Pancham was supposed to be in is lost.

videos.title: Pintu's Remarriage
videos.overview: Pancham's stomach problems continue and Pinkyji sees him again. Murari continues to look for Pancham through the telescope. Pintu is harassed by her lovers at the market. She is supposed to choose one of them.

videos.title: Murari Learns The Truth
videos.overview: Murari learns the reality of Pancham's space travel from the news. He asks Pancham and then gets to know everything. Pinkyji also comes and starts blabbering just to get ignored by all. Elaichi makes tea for everyone the next day.

videos.title: Marriage Plan
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham plan to get married. The good news is that the astrologer has told Murari to get Elaichi married to a poor person. Elaichi, Pancham, and Pintu make and execute an amazing plan.

videos.title: Murari Wants Pancham to Marry Elaichi
videos.overview: Elaichi gives Murari a hint that Pancham and Murari go off to speak to Pancham. Murari tells him to marry Elaichi and for that, he will get some money as well. The next day Pancham tells his decision to Murari.

videos.title: Marriage Day
videos.overview: Elaichi comes for shopping at her father's shop. She is very excited and so is Pancham. They sit for their marriage. Murari is being miserly as he doesn't want this marriage to be permanent. Someone rings the bell and they hurry up and hide.

videos.title: Marriage Repetition
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham are in the middle of the marriage ritual when Pinkyji comes. Everything is removed and Murari takes care of him. After a while, they all come back and the marriage restarts. In the middle of the rituals, someone else comes again.

videos.title: Marriage Accomplished
videos.overview: The marriage rituals of Pancham and Elaichi continue but in the middle, the policeman arrives and talks to Elaichi's father about some pictures. Meanwhile, Elaichi's father gets frustrated and scolds the priest to complete the marriage soon.

videos.title: Pancham In Distress
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi are discussing their future life, when suddenly Pinky arrives and tries some unusual acts on Pancham. Pancham and Elaichi don't get anything, but later Pinky reveals that it was Seth ji's plan.

videos.title: Elaichi's Tantrums
videos.overview: Elaichi complains Pancham for taking her to eat ice cream. Pancham tries consoling her by promising her that he will take her to some luxurious ice cream parlour. Later Sethji create trouble for Pancham.

videos.title: Sonpalji's New Bike
videos.overview: Sonpalji has a drastic transformation and is trying to flirt with Pintu. He also buys a new bike and is doing stunts near Pintu's house. However, Pintu escapes and Sonpal has to take Elaichi's mother to the market.

videos.title: Pinkyji's Stern Rules
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi are stopped by Pinkyji on the road and he charges them with a fine of twenty-five thousand rupees. He also explains to them that he cannot help them as he has a lot of pressure from his superior officers.

videos.title: Another Traffic Challan
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi take Murari's scooter and go out for a ride. They get caught again by Pinkyji and they are fined heavily. Murari comes to the shop and speaks to Pinkyji about the money. On the other hand, Sonpalji's bike is seized by the bank for being a defaulter on the loan.

videos.title: Pinkyji's Fraud
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham get a remedy for their challan and save themselves from Murari. On the other hand, Pinkyji is caught by his superior doing fraud as traffic police. Pinkyji is forgiven and promises to return all the people all their money.

videos.title: Pancham Speaks Up
videos.overview: Murari has been mistreating Pancham lately and he was upset about it. Elaichi and Pintu encourage him to speak up and to be a man. The next time Murari shouts on him, Pancham shouts back.

videos.title: Murari Fires Pancham
videos.overview: Pancham tried to be a man as Elaichi told him to be. However, it turned out to be costly for him. He is fired by Murari and has to leave the house. They manage to stay in the jail for the time being.

videos.title: Elaichi is Missing Her Husband
videos.overview: Elaichi and her friend miss their husband and boyfriend respectively and discuss how to recover from the situation. Later Elaichi tries to flirt with one of her father's employees.

videos.title: Panchams Plan
videos.overview: Pancham and Pintu are staying in jail and they have set their home there. On the other hand, Pancham tries out a trick with which he will get his job back. The plan works pretty well and all Pancham needs to do is ask for forgiveness to Murari.

videos.title: Murari is Still Angry
videos.overview: Pancham tries to fix his issues with Murari and tries multiple times. However, Murari is very angry and sends Pancham away. They are making a new plan for fixing the issue.

videos.title: Thieves On The Terrace
videos.overview: Pancham and Pintu are sleeping on the terrace when Chatanki and Murari go to the terrace to check for thieves. Pancham and Pintu beat them and run away. Later Elaichi gets another idea and Pinkyji comes to file the report.

videos.title: Nothing Seems to Work
videos.overview: Murari and Karu understand the importance of Pancham and Pintu. Then Pancham and Pintu pose to be very distressed and upset out of poverty. Murari is still not convinced of it.

videos.title: Pancham Leaves Delhi
videos.overview: Pancham and Pintu are frustrated by their failed attempts. Pancham tries another attempt but things go sideways. Murari takes Pancham to Pinkyji and they are warned not to be seen in Delhi anymore.

videos.title: Sanjana and Sanjeev
videos.overview: Pancham and Pintu are tired and frustrated about their loss of job and home. At that time Elaichi gets an idea and comes to them. They change their look and Pancham turns into Sanjana, whereas, Pintu turns into Sanjeev. They come to Murari and get the job.

videos.title: Sanjana Settles Down
videos.overview: Sanjana and Sanjeev settle down in the house and they are hungry before sleeping. Karu convinces Murari to take some food for them but before that Elaichi takes all the food up for them.

videos.title: New Jobs
videos.overview: Sanjeev and Sanjana get to their new work. They are both facing difficulties and are having second thoughts. Murari is very happy with his new tenants and Elaichi curbs Pinkyji from registering the workers again.

videos.title: At The Cinema Hall
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi are spotted at the cinema hall and this could be informed to Murari. On the other hand, Murari is having a tough time in training Sanjeev to do the work at the shop.

videos.title: Chatanki Gets All The Blame
videos.overview: Pancham and Elaichi are in the shop at night and they are spending some time when Chatanki comes. He tries to find out who is there but fails. Elaichi and Pancham escape and thereafter, Chatanki tries to steal money. He gets caught by Karu and Murari.

videos.title: Under The Table
videos.overview: Sanjana and Elaichi are teasing each other. They are pushing each other from under the table. After a while, Sanjana starts doing that with Chatankli by mistake. This causes a misunderstanding.

videos.title: Chatanki Versus Pancham
videos.overview: Elaichi and Sanjana go out for touring Chandni Chowk. Sanjana changes out and Pancham is out with Elaichi at a park. Chantanki sees them when they had to lie about the situation. Pancham and Chatanki get into a fight.

videos.title: Sanjana Breaks Chatanki's Heart
videos.overview: Sanjana is in her room when Chatanki comes to her and almost forces to apply soorma on her eyes. At the moment Sanjeev saves her and when Chatanki asks her whether she loves him or not, he gets a shock. Sanjana tells him that she doesn't like him or anything.

videos.title: Sanjeev is Released
videos.overview: Elaichi speaks to the barber and tells him that he is losing out on the credit of beating Chatanki as Sanjeev is in jail for the same. The barber goes on to confess at the station and Sanjeev is released.

videos.title: Sanjana Agrees to Marry Chatanki
videos.overview: Chatanki tells everyone that he wants to marry Sanjana otherwise he will drink poison and commit suicide. Sanjana agrees to marry him. Chatanki starts to irritate her more after this.

videos.title: The Engagement Ceremony
videos.overview: All get ready for the engagement of Chatanki and Sanjana, whereas Chatanki out of excitement reaches Sanjana's bedroom. Later, all the guests arrive and in the presence of all, the ceremony starts. And after certain tantrums of Sanjana, the event gets completed.

videos.title: Teaching Sanjeev The Job
videos.overview: Chatanki and Elaichi ensure that Sanjeev is not fired from his job and Murari reconsiders his decision. Murari and Sonpal try to work hard and teach Sanjeev how to do the job.

videos.title: Elaichi is Upset With Sanjana
videos.overview: Sanjana and Elaichi are upset with one another. They have an argument and later fix the problem themselves. Later Pinkyji is asked by his seniors to be attentive near a jewellery shop as there is a possibility of theft. Pinkyji goes on to arrest Chatanki.

videos.title: Elaichis New Plan
videos.overview: Sanjana goes to the jail to bring food for Chatanki and instead Chatanki pulls her and kisses her. Elaichi and gang plan another remedy. They go to a makeshift place and shoot a video.

videos.title: Pretentious Pancham
videos.overview: Elaichi lies to Murari about pushing Pintu down the mountain. Murari is scared and just then Pancham comes and pretends that he is looking for his wife Pintu. Pancham continues to pretend and act in front of Murari.

videos.title: Murari Tries to Manage The Situation
videos.overview: Pinkyji comes to Murari's house and checks whether everyone is fine. Murari is scared as he has abducted Pancham and kept him in the other room. Later he tries to negotiate with Pancham.

videos.title: Pancham to Marry Himself
videos.overview: Pancham is getting back his job at Murari's shop and on the other hand, he asked to get remarried hoping it would be with Elaichi. Murari tells Sanjana that she has to marry Pancham. It means Pancham is to marry himself.

videos.title: The Last Resort
videos.overview: Murari is close to fixing Pancham and Sanjanas marriage. Sanjana and Elaichi go to Chatanki as he is their last resort. They provoke him to get out and save Sanjana and leave. Chatanki is all charged up and nothing can stop him now.

videos.title: Pancham Gets a Beating
videos.overview: Chatanki ensures that Pancham is beaten and his legs are broken. Pancham is suffering and Chatanki is visited in prison by Karu and Murari. Murari calls Pancham in that condition to meet Sanjana.

videos.title: Murari Meets Sanjana and Pancham
videos.overview: Murari wants to keep Sanjana safe and doesn't want Pancham to be alone in the room with her. After a lot of resistance from Elaichi, Murari reaches the room. Pancham talks to him as both himself as well as Sanjana.

videos.title: Pinkyji Learns The Truth
videos.overview: Pinkyji gets the video where Elaichi pretends to kill Pintu. Pinkyji goes to Murari's house straight away. However, when he tells them about the reason why he is there, Karu hits Pinkyji and allows Elaichi to run.

videos.title: Chatanki Kidnaps Pintu
videos.overview: Pinkyji comes to Murari's house to inform him about the police not being able to find Pintu. Just then Chatanki calls Pancham and tells him that Pintu is in his custody. But Pinkyji seems to believe that this is all a play.

videos.title: Sanjana Weds Chatanki
videos.overview: Chatanki is adamant about revealing Pintu's whereabouts only after tying the knot with Sanjana and hence takes his jail mate to perform the wedding ritual through a video call.

videos.title: Pintu is Rescued
videos.overview: Elaichi walks down the basement and finds Pintu tied to a chair with explosives strapped to her. Pinkyji finds them too but realizes that the bomb will set off any minute.

videos.title: The Special Night
videos.overview: Just as Sanjana and Elaichi prepare to leave, Chatanki drops yet another shocker when he asks Sanjana to stay back. Chatanki further suggests that he and Sanjana's special night be completed.

videos.title: Sanjana is In a Tight Spot
videos.overview: Chatanki gets a honeymoon package as a gift and is happy with it. Sanjana is getting deeper in trouble and hence Elaichi throws a tantrum. Sanjana also misplaces her fake hair in the morning. She even gets stuck in the washroom with Murari.

videos.title: Sanjana Becomes a Nightmare
videos.overview: Sanjana wakes up in the middle of the night and acts as if she is possessed. Chatanki is scared of because of the incident. Moreover, the next day Pintu and Elaichi help Sanjana to scare Chatanki even more. Fear is seeming to be the best way out of the mess they are in.

videos.title: Pintu and Jijaji are Back
videos.overview: The ultimate plan is to beat up Chatanki and they do it. Later Sanjana and Sanjeev pose as goons and escape. Later Jijaji and Pintu come and start handling things from where the other two had left. Murari is convinced by Elaichi and gives them the job back.

videos.title: Elaichi Confesses Her Relationship
videos.overview: Shethji faints eating pumpkin dish and everyone takes him to the hospital assuming it as a  heart attack while it was just due to acidity. Elaichi takes a step and confesses to her parents that she is in love with Pancham and they are married. After listening to the confession, Elaichis parents got astonished.

videos.title: Pancham Loses His Memory
videos.overview: Elaichi is speaking the truth about her relationship with her parents and on the other hand, Pancham gets a major electric shock. Out of the shock, he forgets most of the things that happened in the past two years. Elaichi plans to win him back and bring back his memories.

videos.title: Elaichi Tries Even Harder
videos.overview: Elaichi's mischief doesn't do the trick on Pancham and he gets angrier instead. Elaichi is upset and plans for another tactic to win Pancham like the last time. She plans to get Pancham involved in a mess and later wants to go and save him.

videos.title: The Ransom Calls
videos.overview: Pancham has been accused of stealing from Sethji and receives pictures of himself showcasing the same. He gets a ransom call stating about the incidence and asking for money. Pancham is triggered and is helpless.

videos.title: Problems All Around
videos.overview: Elaichi informs Pintu about the increase in the amount of kidnappers demand which gets reverted by Pancham as well. Later Pancham and Elaichi plan for a movie date where they are getting caught by Sethji but they escape from the scene. Later Sethji gets a clue about the stolen money.

videos.title: Pancham Gets Caught
videos.overview: Sethji sees the snaps where Pancham is stealing his money. He returns home and informs Elaichi about the same. Sethji is ready to sue Pancham for the act but suddenly someone else confesses that he had stolen the money.

videos.title: Elaichi's Mischiefs
videos.overview: Early morning, Elaichi reaches the roof with a cup of tea while Pancham is practicing a song. Pancham ignores her but she puts her effort best in disturbing him. Sethji is in love with the blanket due to the tickling cold and blames his fate for marrying his wife.

videos.title: Pancham's Proposal
videos.overview: Elaichi prank calls Pancham stating it's the call from a record label and that they require him to sing a romantic song for their upcoming album. To get the romantic vibes Pancham proposes to Elaichi and she slaps him.

videos.title: Double Date
videos.overview: Elaichi agrees to date Pancham as his fake lover. As a result, Pancham takes a day off by lying to Murari. On the other hand, Murari and Karu also go to the same park where Pancham and Elaichi have gone for their date. Elaichi escapes but Pancham gets caught.

videos.title: Pancham Catches a Cold
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham come on the terrace at night with the excuse of romance. Pancham is already feeling cold when Murari and Karu come up to the terrace. Lacking options, Pancham has to get inside the water tank in the cold water. The next morning, he catches a cold and Elaichi is still more interested in teaching him how to be romantic.

videos.title: Elaichi Gets Caught
videos.overview: Elaichi's plan of prank calling Pancham comes to an end. Pancham catches her prank calling him and even she asks him to be more romantic with his voice. Pancham gets angry but Elaichi figures out ways to apologize.

videos.title: Murari's Compulsions
videos.overview: Elaichi is sad that her husband doesn't remember that he has a wife. Later, Murari refuses to help Karu when she falls down. Chatanki speaks to Murari on behalf of his sister. Later, Karu falls again and yet again Murari has another excuse for not helping Karu.

videos.title: The Scripted Sleepwalking
videos.overview: Elaichi, Pintu and his girlfriend script Pancham's sleepwalking. They script a scene and pretend in such a way that it makes Pancham feel like he had a sleepwalking incident and went to sleep in Elaichi's room. On the other hand, Murari and Karu have another fight.

videos.title: Mischievous Elaichi
videos.overview: Elaichi continues to script Pancham's sleepwalking. When Pancham wakes up, he finds himself in Elaichis room. Elaichi cries and states he tried to kiss her and slept in her room. Pancham spends the rest of the day apologising to Elaichi.

videos.title: Pancham Gets an Offer
videos.overview: Pancham finds out about the sleeping tablets by which Elaichi was faking his sleepwalking and gets angry. Elaichi explains him saying it was a prank and later when Pancham is singing, Khasote hears him and offers him to sing in Dubai's new year show. Later, Elaichi tries to convince Pancham saying she will come along with him to sing as a couple.

videos.title: Pancham's Singing Partner
videos.overview: Elaichi plays the role of a maid in Sunita's house named Lajvanti. She doesn't show Pancham her face and later makes him believe that she sings like an angel. Pancham does exactly what she wanted from him, and that is to ask her to accompany him to Dubai.

videos.title: Karu's Lover From The Past
videos.overview: Pancham is trying to persuade Lajvanti to accompany him to Dubai for his singing opportunity. On the other hand, Lajvanti is not accepting the idea. Later, Karu sends Murari to the washroom and then talks to her lover from the past, Vinod. She tells him to go away and is worried that he has returned after such a long time.

videos.title: Vinod Makes Karu Uncomfortable
videos.overview: Pancham wakes up early to practice his singing and also to impress Lajvanti. On the other hand, Vinod is staying with Karu's family. Vinod is making Karu uncomfortable and is almost blackmailing her. Karu is upset and Chatanki also can't safeguard her this time.

videos.title: Elaichi Agrees to Go With Pancham
videos.overview: Pancham wants to take Lajvanti to go with him to Dubai. But then he realizes, or rather is made to realize that Elaichi is the better option to go with him. Pancham goes and apologizes to Elaichi and then Elaichi agrees to go with him. On the other hand, Karu is still tensed about Vinod staying with her family.

videos.title: Pancham is In Trouble
videos.overview: Firstly, the Dubai trip gets cancelled as Khasote gives them the bad news. Elaichi feels bad as she wouldn't be able to spend time with Pancham. On the other hand, Pancham gives away a Lehenga to a customer for free and Murari needs the same.

videos.title: Glimpses Of Hope
videos.overview: Elaichi comes to the terrace and sings a heartbreaking song in the middle of the night. Out of it, Pancham and Pintu wake up and Pancham is impressed by the singing. He also empathises with Elaichi and goes and speaks to her. Pancham feels bad for her and himself starts crying. Chatanki tries to advise Karu on the scenario with Vinod.

videos.title: Pancham Gets Confused
videos.overview: Elaichi calls Pancham saying she needs him to console her. Pancham tries going out from the shop but gets caught by Murari. Pancham anyway escapes from him and reaches where Elaichi is.

videos.title: Murari Wants to Know
videos.overview: Murari wants Pancham to find out who has broken Elaichi's heart. Pancham suspects and tells him that it is Mr. Dixit's son, Sanju that they have been looking for. Murari is extremely happy about the fact and wants to go forward with the relation. On the other hand, Karu gives Pintu some money and asks them to leave the house.

videos.title: Pancham Gets Scared
videos.overview: It's Lohri night, everyone is dressed up celebrating the festival. Elaichi slightly flirts with Pancham faking that she has hurt her palm. Later that night, Pancham gets scared seeing Elaichi's hair in the dark and lands up thinking her to be a witch.

videos.title: Elaichi's Prank On Pancham
videos.overview: As Elaichi gets aware of Pancham's fear for witches, she hatches a plan with Sunita to scare Pancham even more. She involves Shaboo in her plan and questioning Pancham's bravery at the dinner table, convinces him to visit a haunted tree at midnight.

videos.title: The Witch
videos.overview: Shaboo climbs on Pancham's back and scares him saying that he will have to carry her on his back forever. As per Elaichi's plan, Elaichi, Sunita, and Pintu refuse to acknowledge the presence of Shaboo which scares Pancham more. However, things get interesting as Elaichi's parents get aware of the fact that a witch is residing at their house.

videos.title: Pintu-pancham's Idea For Chudail to Leave
videos.overview: Shabbo starts to enjoy her current status and demands food from Karuna. Meanwhile Pintu gives Pancham an idea to romance a girl to make the Chudail jealous, so that  Chudail leaves him. Finally they come to an agreement and choose Elaichi. Pancham goes to Elaichi and convinces her to do the drama to get rid of Shabbo.

videos.title: Chudail Se Chhutkara
videos.overview: Murari decides to throw Pancham out of the job but Elaichi tells Chudial to scare Murari and to forbid him from throwing Pancham out. On the other hand, Pancham is feeling relaxed about getting rid from the Chudail.

videos.title: Chudail Track
videos.overview: Elaichi and Shabbo shake hands and discuss their plan when Pancham sees this and gets angry. Pancham confronts both of them and comes out of the room.

videos.title: Sargam's Entry
videos.overview: Pancham and Pintu have a serious fight with each other which Murari notices. Murari requests Pancham to go with the plan which Pancham agrees to after a lot of resistance.

videos.title: Love is In The Air
videos.overview: All the family members meet and greet Sargam. Elaichi and Pancham take Sargam to eat chaat, when the girls get eve-teased, Pancham comes to their rescue. Sargam expresses her liking towards Pancham in front of EIaichi. Elaichi is worried.

videos.title: Jealous Ellaichi
videos.overview: Elaichi fools Sargam and Pancham by talking like Hanumanji. In the night, all are watching TV when Sargam starts dancing with Pancham making Elaichi jealous. Elaichi gets angry and hits a pot on Pancham's head. Pancham complains to Murari about Elaichi.

videos.title: Sargam Falls For Pancham
videos.overview: Sargam tells her boyfriend over a call that she is not interested in him anymore and she has fallen in love with Pancham. Karuna suggests Murari to get Sargam married to an Indian so he can pay back for everything.

videos.title: Sargam Falls For Pancham
videos.overview: Sargam tells Murari that she is in love with Pancham, making Murari really worried. Murari tries to explain Sargam that why Pancham is not the right guy for her, but fails.

videos.title: Murari Tells Pintu to Divorce Pancham
videos.overview: Elu tells Pintu he will not agree to give divorce to Pancham. Pancham tells Pintu he will take him to Canada. Murari tells Pintu to divorce Pancham and for that he is giving him a blank cheque. Elaichi takes the get up of rickshawala and drives Pancham and Sargam.

videos.title: Elaichi Disguises As Rickshawala
videos.overview: Elaichi takes a disguise of a rickshawala and puts a knife on Pancham's throat. Pancham requests him to let go as he doesn't have any money. Elaichi removes her mask and tells Pancham how can he roam with a girl when he is married to Pintu.

videos.title: Sargam Gets Canada Agreement Papers For Pancham
videos.overview: Pintu tells Murari and Karuna that he is ready to get married to Chatanki. Elaichi hits Pintu as her whole plan gets flopped.

videos.title: Elaichi's Serious Dramatization
videos.overview: Elachi tells Lalit to take a disguise of a passport agent and delay Pancham's passport. She also tells Pintu to behave badly with Karuna so that she starts disliking her and cancels marriage with Chatanki. Meanwhile Sargam decides to go for a movie with Pancham and Elachi does a drama to stop them. Elaichi requests Pancham to take her to the doctor. Pancham and Sargam's plan cancels.

videos.title: Elaichi's Tactic Backfires
videos.overview: Pintu insults Karuna but she gets impressed and gives kangan to Pintu. Pacham figures out Elaichi's plan. Pancham apologizes Sargam for his behavior and Sargam again asks Murari if she can go out with Pancham for shopping.

videos.title: Elaichis Plan Works
videos.overview: Elaichi calls Pancham with an excuse fake eve-teasing. Pancham rushes to save her and Sargam's plan flops again. Pintu insults Karuna, making her angry this time. Karuna demands Chatanki to tell Pintu to behave properly.

videos.title: Pancham's Passport Rolls In
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham return. When Sargam sees them together, she gets jealous. Sargam tells her father to make Pancham's passport at the earliest. Lalit comes and tells Pancham that his passport cant be made. A courier boy arrives at that very moment and delivers the passport to Pancham. Elaichi is shocked. Pancham is about to leave making  Pintu emotional.

videos.title: Nayi Aasha
videos.overview: Elaichi is sad after Pancham leaves for Canada, but she finds a glitter of hope when Pancham and Sargam return from the airport itself because of heavy snowfall in Canada. She again starts planning to stop Pancham from leaving permanently.

videos.title: Lalit Turns Astrologer
videos.overview: Pintu isn't able to persuade Pancham against going to Canada. Seeing an astrologer in the market, Elaichi comes up with a plan to stop Pancham. Lalit disguises as a Baba and forecasts that Murari will have a hard time when Pancham leaves.

videos.title: Murari Smells Pyjama
videos.overview: To stop Pancham from going to Canada, Lalit disguises as an astrologer. He brainwashes Murari into believing the presence of a man who is secretively helping him. Convincing Murari of his magical smelling powers, Astrologer Lalit points to Pancham's pyjamas and declares Pancham as Murari's helper. When an overwhelmed Murari calls Pancham home immediately, he gets uncomfortable seeing him smelling his pyjamas.

videos.title: Murari Boxes Pancham
videos.overview: Pancham is going to Canada and Elaichi is upset. So, she and Murari plan to scare Pancham with a rubber snake, but the plan fails as Pancham realises that the snake is fake. With all effort failing, Elaichi next proposes a boxing match between Murari and Pancham. The winner of the match would have the final say on Pancham's Canada Visit.

videos.title: Murari Vs Pancham
videos.overview: Murari, in the hope of stopping Pancham from going to Canada, challenges him to a boxing match. Seeing this as an opportunity, Ellaichi puts a weakness pill in Pancham's milk, which proves detrimental to her own plan when Murari, accidentally, drinks it and loses the match. Will Pancham still go to Canada?

videos.title: Ellaichis New Plan
videos.overview: Though upset with her failure, Ellaichi doesn't give up. She and Murari offer Pancham a half the partnership of Murari's shop to stop him from leaving for Canada. Dixit and Sanju though come and spoil the plan.

videos.title: Pancham has an Affair
videos.overview: Pintu sends Pancham away, while Elu puts Suus hair on Pancham's shirt. At the dining table Elu impatiently waits for Sargam to notice the hair. She hopes that Sargam will get jealous, but Pancham arrives wearing a shirt gifted to him by Sargam. Everyone is shocked. Elu puts plan B in action by putting a lipstick mark on Pancham's shirt and Murari and Elaichi discuss with Sargam about the possibility of Pancham having an affair. Sargam is taken aback. Is Pancham really having an affair?

videos.title: Sargam Proposes Pancham
videos.overview: Pancham comes home, but Elaichi and Murari find no lipstick mark on his shirt. They are shocked. What Elaichi and Murari dont know is that Pancham has removed the mark with a stain remover. Sargam proposes to Pancham. Murari and Karuna decide to plan something on their own. They then put a golden chain in the room.

videos.title: Who is Chain Thief?
videos.overview: Chatanki steals the Chain from Barsati. Murari calls Mangi and asks him to check everyone. Mangi finds the chain in Chatanki's pocket. Everyone in the Family blames each other for the robbery. Meanwhile, Elaichi goes to Lord Hanuman;s Temple and notices a big bell.

videos.title: Pancham's Memory Comes Back
videos.overview: Pancham's memory comes back. Sargam decides to leave them happily together. On the other hand, Dixit gives a gun to Murari and Murari keeps it. Elaichi and Pancham decide to tell the truth to Murari. Murari tells Pancham that he will shoot anyone who will love Elaichi without his approval.

videos.title: Pintu is Pregnant
videos.overview: Elaichi and Pancham tell Murari about marriage, but since Murari has wax in his ears, he fails to hear them properly. Pancham and Elaichi are shocked to see Murari's reaction. Murari thinks Pintu is pregnant. Karuna tells Murari that she will keep a prayer for them. Elaichi is taken aback.

videos.title: Is Pintu Pregnant?
videos.overview: Elaichi tells Pancham to get dressed as Murari has accepted their relationship. Later, Elaichi and Pancham come to Murari to seek his blessings. They are surprised when Murari happily gives them his blessings. What they dont know is that Murari thinks they are there to receive blessings for Pintu's pregnancy. We play on Murari's misunderstanding as Elaichi and Pancham become even more confident of their relationships acceptance by Murari. Meanwhile, Chatanki is upset about Pintu's pregnancy. He goes to house. There, he sees Pancham and Pintu are fighting. Chatanki rushes to his sister to tell her everything.

videos.title: Karuna Knows Elaichi's Secret
videos.overview: Murari forces Elaichi to buy a dress for Pintu's baby shower, but Elaichi thinks that it is for her wedding. On the other hand, Karuna learns that Elaichi and Pancham are married. She tries to indirectly question Murari about his views on something which really angers him. Later, Karuna tells Pancham and Elaichi that Murari will never accept their relationship and he even has a gun with him.

videos.title: Murari Knows About The Affair
videos.overview: Dixit informs Murari about Elaichi and Pancham's affair. Murari along with Karuna takes Pintu to watch a movie in the theatre. Pintu agrees to go so that Pancham and Elaichi will have some time alone. As all of them are in the theatre, Murari tells Karuna that he is going to fake a stomach ache and return home to catch Pancham and Elaichi red hand. Will Murari succeed in his plan?

videos.title: Chatanki Stalks Pancham
videos.overview: Karuna asks Pancham and Elaichi to tell the truth about their marriage to Murari. On the other hand, Murari asks Chatanki to keep an eye on Panchan and Elaichi.  Murari schemes to send to Pancham and Elaichi out of the house to catch them red handed. But Pancham is already aware of Murari's plan so he refuses to go out. Later, Murari asks Elaichi to marry a suitable boy, but Elaichi refuses. Murari smells something really fishy.

videos.title: Murari Shoots Pancham
videos.overview: Pancham knows all about Murari's plan so he tells Elaichi to meet the boy and play along with Murari. Therefore, Elaichi agrees with Murari to meet the boy. Murari feels relax about it. After a while, Murari watches Pancham applying vermilion on Elaichi's forehead. Later, when Pancham and Elaichi reveal that they are married to Murari, he goes wild and shoots Pancham.
